Uma redução em lesões em pessoas, mas um aumento nos incidentes envolvendo dano material
Um sistema mais eficiente será desenvolvido para fins de atribuir culpa
CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.answer: Uma redução ou até eliminação desses incidentes no futuro

CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.question: Which ONE of the following best describes how the narrative section of an incident investigation report should be written? Select the ONE best answer.
options: An orderly description of the events leading up to the incident, what happened during the incident itself, the consequences and the post-incident actions, written in a neutral way, without opinion or judgment.
A random description of the events preceding an incident and the corrective actions necessary to prevent a recurrence, written in a neutral way, but including the investigator’s summary assessment.
A detailed account of the incident, reflecting, so far as possible, the investigator’s understanding of the circumstances and including recommendations for the attention of management.
CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.answer: An orderly description of the events leading up to the incident, what happened during the incident itself, the consequences and the post-incident actions, written in a neutral way, without opinion or judgment.

CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.question: 以下哪个说法最好地描述了事件调查报告的叙述部分应该怎样编写？ 请选择一个最佳答案。
options: 按顺序描述导致事件的一系列小事件、事件本身的情况、结果和事件后的措施，以中立态度编写，不带观点或判断。
随意描述事件之前的一系列小事件、防止再次发生的必需的修正措施，以中立态度编写，但包括调查员的总结性评估。
事件的详细信息，尽可能反映调查员对情况的理解，包括管理层要注意的建议。
CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.answer: 按顺序描述导致事件的一系列小事件、事件本身的情况、结果和事件后的措施，以中立态度编写，不带观点或判断。

CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.question: ¿CUÁL de las siguientes afirmaciones describe mejor cómo se debe escribir la sección narrativa del informe de investigación de un incidente? Seleccione LA mejor respuesta.
options: Una descripción ordenada de los eventos que desembocaron en el incidente, qué sucedió durante el propio incidente, las consecuencias y las acciones llevadas a cabo tras el incidente; todo ello redactado con un tono neutro, sin opiniones ni juicios de valor.

Una descripción aleatoria de los eventos anteriores a un incidente y las medidas correctivas necesarias para que no se vuelva a producir; todo ello redactado con un tono neutro, pero incluyendo la valoración resumida del investigador.
Un relato detallado del incidente, reflejando, en la medida de lo posible, la interpretación que realiza el investigador acerca de las circunstancias y recomendaciones a la atención de la dirección.
CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.answer: Una descripción ordenada de los eventos que desembocaron en el incidente, qué sucedió durante el propio incidente, las consecuencias y las acciones llevadas a cabo tras el incidente; todo ello redactado con un tono neutro, sin opiniones ni juicios de valor.

CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.question: Quelle proposition décrit le mieux la manière de rédiger la section narrative du rapport d'enquête sur un incident ? Sélectionnez une SEULE réponse, selon celle qui vous semble la meilleure.
options: Une description chronologique des événements entraînant l'incident, des événements survenus pendant l'incident lui-même, des conséquences et des actions postérieures à l'incident, le tout rédigé de manière neutre, sans apporter d'opinion ni porter de jugement.

Une description aléatoire des événements précédant un incident et des actions correctives nécessaires pour empêcher toute réapparition, le tout rédigé de manière neutre mais intégrant une évaluation de l'enquêteur sous la forme d'un résumé.
Un compte-rendu détaillé de l'incident, reflétant autant que possible la compréhension de l'enquêteur des circonstances et contenant des recommandations destinées à la direction.
CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.answer: Une description chronologique des événements entraînant l'incident, des événements survenus pendant l'incident lui-même, des conséquences et des actions postérieures à l'incident, le tout rédigé de manière neutre, sans apporter d'opinion ni porter de jugement.

CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.question: Quale delle seguenti descrizioni corrisponde al metodo da seguire per redigere la sezione del rapporto dedicata al racconto dei fatti? Selezionare UNA SOLA risposta.
options: Una descrizione ordinata degli eventi che hanno portato all'evento negativo, di cosa sia accaduto, delle conseguenze e delle azioni post-incidente, resa in modo neutro e senza esprimere opinioni né giudizi.

Una descrizione causale degli eventi precedenti l'evento negativo e delle azioni correttive volte a impedire che si ripeta, resa in modo neutro, ma comprendente la valutazione sintetica dell'investigatore.
Un resoconto dettagliato dell'incidente, che rispecchi il più possibile la comprensione delle circostanze da parte dell'investigatore, e comprendente raccomandazioni rivolte alla dirigenza.
CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.answer: Una descrizione ordinata degli eventi che hanno portato all'evento negativo, di cosa sia accaduto, delle conseguenze e delle azioni post-incidente, resa in modo neutro e senza esprimere opinioni né giudizi.

CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.question: QUAL das seguintes opções melhor descreve a maneira como se deve escrever a seção narrativa de um relatório de investigação de incidente? Selecione A melhor resposta.
options: Uma descrição organizada dos eventos que levaram ao incidente, o que aconteceu durante o próprio incidente, as consequências e as ações pós-incidente, escrita de maneira neutra, sem opinião ou julgamento.

Uma descrição aleatória dos eventos que antecederam um incidente e as ações corretivas necessárias para evitar recorrência, escrita de maneira neutra, mas incluindo a avaliação resumida do investigador.
Um relato detalhado do incidente, refletindo, na medida do possível, o entendimento que o investigador tem das circunstâncias e incluindo recomendações para a atenção da gerência.
CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.answer: Uma descrição organizada dos eventos que levaram ao incidente, o que aconteceu durante o próprio incidente, as consequências e as ações pós-incidente, escrita de maneira neutra, sem opinião ou julgamento.

CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.question: What is the purpose of incident investigation? Select the ONE best answer.
options: To establish the facts and prevent a repeat of the incident. It is not to allocate blame.
Mainly to allocate blame, and also identify relevant contributory factors. It may suggest corrective action.
To draw up corrective action, including disciplinary procedures where appropriate. Contributory factors may not necessarily be identified.
The completion of the necessary forms, so that an auditor can see that a system for documenting incidents exists.
CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.answer: To establish the facts and prevent a repeat of the incident. It is not to allocate blame.

CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.question: 事件调查的目的是什么？ 请选择一个最佳答案。
options: 为了查出事实，防止事件重复发生。不是要进行责备。
主要是为了进行责备，还为了确定相关原因。可能隐含修正措施。
为了采取修正措施，包括适合的纪律程序。可能不必查明原因。
填写必需表单，以便审核者可以看到体系内记录了事件的存在。
CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.answer: 为了查出事实，防止事件重复发生。不是要进行责备。

CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.question: ¿Cuál es la finalidad de una investigación de incidentes? Seleccione LA mejor respuesta.
options: Establecer los hechos y evitar que se repita el incidente. El objetivo no es determinar quiénes son los culpables.
Principalmente, establecer quiénes son los culpables, y también identificar los factores determinantes relevantes. Podría desembocar en acciones correctivas.
Establecer una acción correctiva, incluidos procedimientos disciplinarios, si fuera el caso. No es absolutamente necesario identificar los factores determinantes.
La cumplimentación de los formularios necesarios para que un auditor pueda verificar que existe un sistema para la documentación de incidentes.
CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.answer: Establecer los hechos y evitar que se repita el incidente. El objetivo no es determinar quiénes son los culpables.

CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.question: Quel est l'objectif de l'enquête sur un incident ? Sélectionnez une SEULE réponse, selon celle qui vous semble la meilleure.
options: Établir les faits et empêcher que l'incident se produise à nouveau. Il n'est pas destiné à trouver un coupable.
Principalement pour rechercher un coupable et pour identifier les facteurs pertinents qui ont contribué à l'incident. Elle peut suggérer une mesure de correction.
Pour établir une mesure de correction, y compris les mesures disciplinaires, le cas échéant. Il n'est pas nécessaire d'identifier les facteurs contributifs.
Le renseignement des formulaires nécessaires de manière à ce qu'un auditeur puisse constater qu'un système de documentation des incidents existe.
CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.answer: Établir les faits et empêcher que l'incident se produise à nouveau. Il n'est pas destiné à trouver un coupable.

CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.question: Qual è lo scopo di condurre inchieste su un incidente? Selezionare UNA SOLA risposta.
options: Accertare i fatti e prevenire il ripetersi del sinistro, non individuare il responsabile.
Innanzitutto individuare il responsabile, quindi accertare possibili fattori che hanno concorso al sinistro. Può suggerire opportune azioni correttive.
Adottare azioni correttive, inclusi, se necessario, procedimenti disciplinari. Eventuali fattori che hanno concorso al sinistro potrebbero non essere identificati.
Compilare i necessari moduli per dimostrare agli ispettori l'esistenza di un sistema di documentazione degli incidenti.
CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.answer: Accertare i fatti e prevenire il ripetersi del sinistro, non individuare il responsabile.

CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.question: Qual é a finalidade da investigação de incidentes? Selecione A melhor resposta.
options: Estabelecer os fatos e evitar a recorrência do incidente. Não é atribuir culpa.
Principalmente atribuir culpa, além de identificar fatores relevantes que contribuíram para o incidente. Ela pode sugerir ação corretiva.
Definir ações corretivas, incluindo procedimentos disciplinares quando adequado. Os fatores que contribuíram para o incidente não são necessariamente identificados.
O preenchimento dos formulários necessários, para que o auditor possa ver que existe um sistema para documentar incidentes.
CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.answer: Estabelecer os fatos e evitar a recorrência do incidente. Não é atribuir culpa.

El agente de embarque

CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.answer: El capitán

CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.question: Qui est désigné pour représenter le propriétaire du navire aux fins de communication en lien avec un incident ? Sélectionnez LA réponse correcte.
options: Le capitaine
Le responsable de la sécurité sur le navire
L'agent à l'embarquement
Le responsable de la sécurité sur le navire
CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.answer: Le capitaine

CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.question: Ai fini delle comunicazioni relative a un incidente, chi rappresenta la proprietà della nave? Selezionare l'UNICA risposta esatta.
options: Il comandante.
Il responsabile della sicurezza della nave
L'addetto all'imbarco
Il responsabile della salvaguardia della nave
CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.answer: Il comandante.

CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.question: Para fins de comunicações relacionadas a um incidente, quem é nomeado representante do proprietário da embarcação? Selecione UMA resposta correta.
options: O comandante
O Oficial de Segurança do navio
O agente de embarque
O Oficial de Segurança do navio
CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.answer: O comandante

CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.question: As described in this training program, what is the most valuable outcome of an incident investigation? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: New control measures to prevent a similar incident in the future
A good report that will impress an auditor
The statistics it produces
That the Company can demonstrate that it investigates incidents in compliance with the ISM Code and other legislation
CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.answer: New control measures to prevent a similar incident in the future

CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.question: 正如本培训计划中描述的那样，事件调查最有价值的结果是什么？ 请选择一个正确答案。
options: 用来防止将来发生类似事件的新控制措施
显示审核者的良好报告
产生的统计数据
公司可以表明它根据 ISM Code 和其他法规调查了事件
CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.answer: 用来防止将来发生类似事件的新控制措施

CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.question: Tal y como se describe en este programa de formación, ¿cuál es el resultado más valioso de la investigación de un incidente? Seleccione la ÚNICA respuesta correcta.
options: Nuevas medidas de control para evitar que se produzca un incidente similar en el futuro
Un buen informe que deje impresionado al auditor
Las estadísticas que se generan
Que la empresa pueda demostrar que investiga los incidentes de acuerdo con lo establecido en el código IGS y en otras normativas
CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.answer: Nuevas medidas de control para evitar que se produzca un incidente similar en el futuro

CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.question: Quel est le résultat le plus précieux obtenu par une enquête sur un incident tel qu'il est décrit dans ce programme de formation ? Sélectionnez LA réponse correcte.
options: De nouvelles mesures de contrôle destinées à empêcher qu'un incident similaire se produise à l'avenir.
Un bon rapport qui impressionnera un auditeur.
Les statistiques que le rapport produit.
Le fait que la compagnie puisse démontrer qu'elle enquête sur les incidents en conformité avec le Code ISM et avec toute autre législation.
CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.answer: De nouvelles mesures de contrôle destinées à empêcher qu'un incident similaire se produise à l'avenir.

CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.question: In base a questo programma di formazione, qual è il risultato più importante di un'inchiesta su un incidente? Selezionare l'UNICA risposta esatta.
options: L'adozione di misure di controllo per prevenire eventi analoghi in futuro
Un rapporto ben fatto che faccia una buona impressione sugli ispettori
Le statistiche che si potranno stilare sulla base dei suoi risultati
Che la compagnia potrà dimostrare che svolge inchieste sugli incidenti in conformità all'ISM Code e alle altre normative
CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.answer: L'adozione di misure di controllo per prevenire eventi analoghi in futuro

CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.question: Conforme dito neste programa de treinamento, qual é o resultado mais valioso de uma investigação de incidente? Selecione UMA resposta correta.
options: Novas medidas de controle para evitar um incidente semelhante no futuro
Um bom relatório que impressionará um auditor
As estatísticas geradas por ela
A empresa poder demonstrar que investiga incidentes em conformidade com o Código ISM e outras leis
CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.answer: Novas medidas de controle para evitar um incidente semelhante no futuro

CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.question: When presenting findings and recommendations in a report for use onboard, which ONE of the following will help to increase understanding and interest? Select the ONE best answer.
options: Avoid using complicated language and keep things simple
Avoid using the ship’s name
Print the report in large type
Print plenty of copies of the report and post them all over the ship
CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.answer: Avoid using complicated language and keep things simple

CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.question: 在供船上使用的报告中呈现发现和建议时，以下哪个选项有助于提高理解力和感兴趣程度？ 请选择一个最佳答案。
options: 避免使用复杂语言，让内容简单化
避免使用船舶名称
打印长篇报告
打印充足的报告副本，在船上张贴
CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.answer: 避免使用复杂语言，让内容简单化

CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.question: A la hora de presentar los resultados y las recomendaciones en un informe para su uso a bordo del buque, ¿CUÁL de las siguientes opciones ayudará a aumentar la comprensión y el interés? Seleccione LA mejor respuesta.
options: Evitar el uso de un lenguaje complicado y simplificar el mensaje
Evitar el uso del nombre del buque
Imprimir el informe con un tipo de letra grande
Imprimir muchas copias del informe y repartirlas por el buque
CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.answer: Evitar el uso de un lenguaje complicado y simplificar el mensaje

CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.question: Lors de la présentation des conclusions et des recommandations dans un rapport destiné à un usage à bord, laquelle des propositions suivantes (UNE) aidera à améliorer la compréhension et à susciter l'intérêt ? Sélectionnez une SEULE réponse, selon celle qui vous semble la meilleure.
options: Éviter d'utiliser un langage complexe et garder les choses simples.
Éviter d'utiliser le nom du navire.
Imprimer le rapport en grands caractères.
Imprimer un grand nombre de copies du rapport et les afficher sur tout le navire.
CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.answer: Éviter d'utiliser un langage complexe et garder les choses simples.

CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.question: Quando si presentano le risultanze e le raccomandazioni in un rapporto da utilizzare a bordo, quale tra le seguenti opzioni favorirà la comprensione e stimolerà l'interesse? Selezionare UNA SOLA risposta.
options: Evitare di utilizzare un linguaggio difficile e privilegiare la semplicità
Evitare di menzionare il nome della nave
Stampare il rapporto a caratteri grandi
Stampare tante copie del rapporto e affiggerle in tutti gli ambienti della nave
CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.answer: Evitare di utilizzare un linguaggio difficile e privilegiare la semplicità

CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.question: Ao apresentar descobertas e recomendações em um relatório para uso a bordo, QUAL das seguintes opções ajudará a aumentar o entendimento e o interesse? Selecione A melhor resposta.
options: Evitar usar linguagem complexa e simplificar as coisas
Evitar usar o nome do navio
Imprimir o relatório com letras grandes
Imprimir muitas cópias do relatório e postá-las por todos os lugares do navio.
CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.answer: Evitar usar linguagem complexa e simplificar as coisas

CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.question: There has been an incident on board the vessel. A newspaper reporter approaches the seaman on duty at the gangway and asks him what happened. He offers $50 for information. How should the seaman be trained to react to such an approach? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: He should not enter into any discussion relating to the incident.  He should refuse admission to the reporter
He should accept the money and politely answer the reporter’s questions
He should call the Bosun on his radio and ask him to come and talk with the reporter
He should do his best to answer the reporter’s questions, but ensure that the man’s name and who he works for is properly recorded in the gangway log
CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.answer: He should not enter into any discussion relating to the incident.  He should refuse admission to the reporter

CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.question: 船舶上发生了事件。某家报纸记者接近舷梯当班海员，询问他发生了什么事情。他给了 50 美元的信息费。经过培训的海员应该如何应对这种情况？ 请选择一个正确答案。
options: 他不应该讨论与该事件相关的任何内容。他应该拒绝记者进入
他应该接受信息费，并礼貌的回答记者问题
他应该在无线电步话机中呼叫商船甲板长，让他来与记者交谈
他应该尽自己最大努力回答记者问题，并确保在舷梯日志中记录此人姓名以及他为谁工作
CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.answer: 他不应该讨论与该事件相关的任何内容。他应该拒绝记者进入

CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.question: Se ha producido un incidente a bordo de la embarcación. Un periodista se acerca al marinero de guardia en la pasarela y le pregunta qué ha sucedido. Le ofrece 50 dólares por la información. ¿Cómo debería reaccionar el marinero ante un acercamiento de este tipo? Seleccione la ÚNICA respuesta correcta.
options: No debería entablar ninguna conversación en relación con el incidente.  Debería denegar el acceso al periodista.
Debería aceptar el dinero y contestar amablemente a las preguntas del periodista.
Debería llamar al contramaestre por radio y pedirle que venga a hablar con el periodista.

Debería contestar del mejor modo posible a las preguntas del periodistas, pero asegurándose de que el nombre del periodista y del medio para el que trabaja quedan correctamente registrados en el diario de la pasarela.
CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.answer: No debería entablar ninguna conversación en relación con el incidente.  Debería denegar el acceso al periodista.

CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.question: Un incident s'est produit à bord du navire. Le reporter d'un journal se rapproche d'un marin en service sur la passerelle et lui demande ce qu'il s'est passé. Il offre 50 USD pour l'information. Comment le marin doit-il être formé à réagir à une telle approche ? Sélectionnez LA réponse correcte.
options: Il ne doit en aucun cas parler de l'incident.  Il doit refuser l'accès au journaliste.
Il doit accepter l'argent et répondre poliment aux questions du journaliste.
Il doit appeler le maître d'équipage sur sa radio et lui demander de venir parler au journaliste.
Il doit faire de son mieux pour répondre aux questions du journaliste mais s'assurer que le nom de la personne et celui de son employeur sont enregistrés correctement sur le journal de la passerelle.
CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.answer: Il ne doit en aucun cas parler de l'incident.  Il doit refuser l'accès au journaliste.

CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.question: Su una nave si è verificato un incidente. Un giornalista avvicina il marittimo addetto alla passerella e gli domanda cosa sia successo. Gli offre cinquanta dollari per l'informazione. Quali istruzioni occorre impartire preventivamente al marittimo, affinché sappia come comportarsi in un caso simile? Selezionare l'UNICA risposta esatta.
options: Non deve parlare con nessuno dell'accaduto  e deve negare l'accesso al giornalista
Può accettare il denaro e rispondere con cortesia alle sue domande
Deve chiamare il nostromo alla radio e chiedergli di venire a parlare con il giornalista
Deve fare del suo meglio per rispondere alle domande, annotando però il nome del giornalista e della sua testata nel registro di passerella
CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.answer: Non deve parlare con nessuno dell'accaduto  e deve negare l'accesso al giornalista

CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.question: Ocorreu um incidente a bordo da embarcação. Um repórter de um jornal aborda um marinheiro de serviço no passadiço e lhe pergunta o que aconteceu. Ele oferece 50 dólares pela informação. Como o marinheiro deve ser treinado para reagir a uma abordagem como essa? Selecione UMA resposta correta.
options: Ele não deve participar de nenhuma discussão relacionada ao incidente.  Ele deve negar a entrada ao repórter
Ele deve aceitar o dinheiro e responder educadamente às perguntas do repórter
Ele deve usar o rádio para pedir que o contramestre venha falar com repórter
Ele deve se esforçar ao máximo para responder às perguntas do repórter, mas se certificando de que o nome do homem e o jornal para o qual ele trabalha sejam registrados no diário do passadiço.
CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.answer: Ele não deve participar de nenhuma discussão relacionada ao incidente.  Ele deve negar a entrada ao repórter

CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.question: What is the definition of “evidence”, as described in this training program? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: Something that demonstrates proof
Something that demonstrates guilt
Information collected for a report
The opinions of witnesses interviewed during an investigation
CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.answer: Something that demonstrates proof

CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.question: 在此培训计划中，“证据”的定义是什么？ 请选择一个正确答案。
options: 用来证明的内容
用来证明有罪的内容
报告收集的信息
调查中面谈的目击者的观点
CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.answer: 用来证明的内容

CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.question: ¿Cuál es la definición de «evidencia», tal y como se describe en este programa de formación? Seleccione la ÚNICA respuesta correcta.
options: Una prueba que demuestra un hecho
Algo que demuestra la culpabilidad
Información recopilada para un informe
Las opiniones de los testigos entrevistados durante una investigación
CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.answer: Una prueba que demuestra un hecho

CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.question: Quelle est la définition d'une « preuve » telle que définie dans ce programme de formation ? Sélectionnez LA réponse correcte.
options: C'est un élément qui démontre la vérité.
C'est un élément qui prouve la culpabilité.
Ce sont des informations recueillies pour un rapport.
Il s'agit de l'opinion des témoins interrogés lors d'une enquête.
CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.answer: C'est un élément qui démontre la vérité.

CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.question: Cosa sono le "prove", in base alla definizione fornita in questo programma di formazione? Selezionare l'UNICA risposta esatta.
options: Sono elementi che attestano un determinato fatto
Sono elementi che dimostrano una colpa
Sono informazioni raccolte per fare un resoconto
Sono le opinioni dei testimoni sentiti durante un'inchiesta
CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.answer: Sono elementi che attestano un determinato fatto

CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.question: Qual é a definição de "evidência" mostrada neste programa de treinamento? Selecione UMA resposta correta.
options: Algo que demonstra prova
Algo que demonstra culpa
Informações coletadas para um relatório
As opiniões de testemunhas entrevistadas durante uma investigação
CD0307 — Incident investigation, Investi.answer: Algo que demonstra prova

CD0310 — Working at height.question: Which one of the options correctly completes the following statement? ‘A full body harness...
options: ...minimises body injury in a fall arrest’.
...maximises body injury in a fall arrest’.
...stops a person falling’.
...is only necessary for falls greater than 10 metres’.
CD0310 — Working at height.answer: ...minimises body injury in a fall arrest’.

CD0310 — Working at height.question: Какой вариант ответа правильно дополняет следующее утверждение? «Полная страховочная привязь...
options: снижает вероятность получения травм при срабатывании системы защиты от падения».
повышает вероятность получения травм во время срабатывания системы защиты от падения».
останавливает падение монтажника».
нужна только в целях предотвращения падения с высоты более 10 метров».
CD0310 — Working at height.answer: снижает вероятность получения травм при срабатывании системы защиты от падения».

CD0310 — Working at height.question: 下面哪个选项正确完成了以下说法？ “全身式安全带...
options: ...最大程度减小了防坠装置中的身体受伤”。
...最大程度增大了防坠装置中的身体受伤”。
...阻止人员坠落”。
...仅在坠落大于 10 米时才需要”。
CD0310 — Working at height.answer: ...最大程度减小了防坠装置中的身体受伤”。

CD0310 — Working at height.question: Which of these is the correct name for a more advanced safety harness than a simple waist belt? Pick the best option.
options: A full body harness.
A waist harness.
A torso harness.
A full body belt.
CD0310 — Working at height.answer: A full body harness.

CD0310 — Working at height.question: Какой тип страховочной привязи является более совершенным типом привязи по сравнению с обычным монтажным поясом? Выберите наиболее подходящий вариант.
options: Полная страховочная привязь.
Нижняя система.
Система фиксации туловища.
Полноразмерный пояс.
CD0310 — Working at height.answer: Полная страховочная привязь.

CD0310 — Working at height.question: 与简单的腰带式安全带相比，更安全的安全带的正确名称是什么？ 请选择最佳答案。
options: 全身式安全带。
腰带式安全带。
躯干式安全带。
全身式皮带。
CD0310 — Working at height.answer: 全身式安全带。

CD0310 — Working at height.question: Is it safe to carry a bag of tools in your hand, up a vertical ladder? Select the best option.
options: No it is not –two hands should always be used to climb the ladder.
Yes it is – provided that the carrying hand is wrapped around the ladder
Yes it is - provided the ship is not rolling too badly
Yes it is – provided three points of contact are maintained.
CD0310 — Working at height.answer: No it is not –two hands should always be used to climb the ladder.

CD0310 — Working at height.question: Безопасно ли нести набор инструментов в руке, поднимаясь по вертикальному трапу? Выберите наиболее подходящий вариант.
options: Небезопасно. Поднимаясь по трапу, следует держаться за него двумя руками.
Безопасно, если рука, которая держит набор инструментов, также держится за трап.
Безопасно, если судно не раскачивается слишком сильно.
Безопасно, если сохраняется три точки контакта.
CD0310 — Working at height.answer: Небезопасно. Поднимаясь по трапу, следует держаться за него двумя руками.

CD0310 — Working at height.question: 攀爬垂直梯子时用手携带工具袋安全吗？ 请选择最佳答案。
options: 不安全 - 务必要使用双手来攀爬梯子。
安全 - 带拿工具的手要环抱梯子
安全 - 条件是船只横摇不太厉害
安全 - 条件是保持三个接触点。
CD0310 — Working at height.answer: 不安全 - 务必要使用双手来攀爬梯子。

CD0310 — Working at height.question: When someone is working at height, who is at risk? Select the best option.
options: There are risks to people at height and anyone below them.
There are risks to the people doing the job only.
There are risks to people working below only.
There are risks to all members of a vessel’s crew.
CD0310 — Working at height.answer: There are risks to people at height and anyone below them.

CD0310 — Working at height.question: Кто подвергается риску при выполнении работ на высоте? Выберите наиболее подходящий вариант.
options: Риску подвергаются монтажники на высоте и все, кто находятся под ними.
Риску подвергаются только монтажники, выполняющие работы на высоте.
Риску подвергаются только люди, находящиеся под местом выполнения работ.
Риску подвергаются все члены экипажа судна.
CD0310 — Working at height.answer: Риску подвергаются монтажники на высоте и все, кто находятся под ними.

CD0310 — Working at height.question: 当某人在高空作业时，谁会处于风险之中？ 请选择最佳答案。
options: 处于高处的人和下面的任何人。
仅执行作业的人员。
仅在下面执行作业的人员。
所有船员。
CD0310 — Working at height.answer: 处于高处的人和下面的任何人。

CD0310 — Working at height.question: Why does a heavy object cause more damage than a light object if dropped from the same height? Select the best answer.
options: It takes more force to stop a heavier object.
There is less force on the heavy object.
Because heavier objects are bigger in size.
Because heavier objects are smaller in size.
CD0310 — Working at height.answer: It takes more force to stop a heavier object.

CD0310 — Working at height.question: Почему тяжелый предмет, упавший с высоты, причиняет больший ущерб, нежели легкий, упавший с такой же высоты? Выберите наиболее подходящий ответ.
options: Чтобы остановить более тяжелый предмет, следует приложить большую силу.
На тяжелый предмет действует меньшая сила.
Размер тяжелых предметов больше.
Размер тяжелых предметов меньше.
CD0310 — Working at height.answer: Чтобы остановить более тяжелый предмет, следует приложить большую силу.

CD0310 — Working at height.question: 从相同高度掉落时，为什么重物比轻物造成的损坏更大？ 请选择最佳答案。
options: 需要更大力才能停止更重的物体。
重物上的力更小。
因为重物更大。
因为重物更小。
CD0310 — Working at height.answer: 需要更大力才能停止更重的物体。

CD0310 — Working at height.question: What is the greatest personal risk when working from a stairway on a vessel? Select the best option.
options: A person may fall down the stairs or over the handrail.
There are none, as the stairways are safe.
Other persons are inconvenienced when trying to pass.
The stairway would have to be out of bounds for others.
CD0310 — Working at height.answer: A person may fall down the stairs or over the handrail.

CD0310 — Working at height.question: Какой самый большой риск, которому подвергается член экипажа, выполняющий работы, стоя на трапе? Выберите наиболее подходящий вариант.
options: Он может упасть с трапа или перевалиться через поручни.
Рисков нет, поскольку трапы абсолютно безопасны.
Другим членам экипажа неудобно проходить по трапу.
Трап не должен быть доступен другим членам экипажа.
CD0310 — Working at height.answer: Он может упасть с трапа или перевалиться через поручни.

CD0310 — Working at height.question: 在船舶楼梯上作业时最大的人员风险是什么？ 请选择最佳答案。
options: 人员可能从楼梯跌落或摔出栏杆。
没有危险，楼梯是很安全的。
别人通过时会不方便。
楼梯必须超出其他装置的边界。
CD0310 — Working at height.answer: 人员可能从楼梯跌落或摔出栏杆。

CD0310 — Working at height.question: Which of these describes a basic safety harness? Pick the best option.
options: A waist belt.
A shoulder belt.
A hip belt.

CD0337 — Fresh water management.question: On a vessel, where should potable water samples be taken? Select the ONE best answer.

CD0338 — Fresh water system sanitation.question: Why can a calorifier be a breeding ground for bacteria? Select the ONE correct answer.

CD0338 — Fresh water system sanitation.question: If a potable water tank has been entered for inspection, what should happen to it before it is put back into use? Select the ONE best answer.

They are sloped helping to keep the cargo in place without the need for trimming
They protect the cargo from collision damage
They raise the centre of gravity of the cargo in the hold
CD0340 — Introduction to bulk carriers.answer: They can be filled with water ballast to raise the vertical centre of gravity of the ship

CD0340 — Introduction to bulk carriers.question: What does ‘OBO’ stand for in relation to bulk carriers? Select ONE correct answer.
options: Oil/Bulk/Ore carrier
Optional Bulk Ore carrier
Open Bulk/Ore carrier
Overseas Bulk Operator
CD0340 — Introduction to bulk carriers.answer: Oil/Bulk/Ore carrier

CD0340 — Introduction to bulk carriers.question: Under a voyage charter who pays for the fuel used by the ship? Select ONE correct answer.
options: The shipowner
The charterer
The shipper
The agent
CD0340 — Introduction to bulk carriers.answer: The shipowner

CD0340 — Introduction to bulk carriers.question: Which ONE of these explains how “sump pumps” are usually powered?
options: Water power
Compressed air
Low voltage electricity
Hydraulic power
CD0340 — Introduction to bulk carriers.answer: Water power

CD0340 — Introduction to bulk carriers.question: Which ONE of these will usually use the Draft Survey hydrometer?
options: The draft surveyor
The ship’s officers
A Port State Control Officer
The cargo shipper
CD0340 — Introduction to bulk carriers.answer: The draft surveyor

CD0340 — Introduction to bulk carriers.question: Which ONE of these is a psychrometer used to measure?
options: The relative humidity of air in a hold, and its dew point
Cargo temperatures
Moisture content of cargoes
The concentration of fumigant left in the hold
CD0340 — Introduction to bulk carriers.answer: The relative humidity of air in a hold, and its dew point

CD0340 — Introduction to bulk carriers.question: When a psychrometer is used for measuring the relative humidity in the air in a hold should the hold ventilation be stopped?
options: Yes
No
CD0340 — Introduction to bulk carriers.answer: Yes

CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.question: What is the IMSBC Code recommendation for the minimum number of times that the can is banged down when carrying out a ‘can test’?
options: 25 times
5 times
15 times
50 times
CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.answer: 25 times

CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.question: Which ONE of the following is responsible for warning a ship about the risk of ‘wet base’ cargoes?
options: The cargo shipper
The charterer
The ship’s agent
The ship’s master
CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.answer: The cargo shipper

CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.question: Which ONE of the following IMSBC Code groupings should be used if 80% of a bulk coal cargo is made up of fine particles and the remaining 20% is larger lumps?
options: Group A and B
Group B only
Group A only
Group C only
CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.answer: Group A and B

CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.question: Although the ‘can test’ is not a substitute for proper laboratory testing, which ONE of the following correctly identifies what a ‘wet’ result should tell the master or mate?
options: That the sample is likely to be above the TML and that there is a risk of cargo liquefaction in the remainder of the cargo presented to the ship
That the sample is likely to be above the TML but the rest of the cargo will probably be safe to load
That the sample is wet but more ‘can tests’ should be carried out to find other dryer samples in the stockpiles so as to get an overall average moisture content which is below the TML
That the sample for the ‘can test’ was taken from too near the surface of the stockpile
CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.answer: That the sample is likely to be above the TML and that there is a risk of cargo liquefaction in the remainder of the cargo presented to the ship

CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.question: Which ONE of the options is the most accurate in relation to the following statement?^M		^M“If moisture migrates to the bottom part of the cargo stow, and ‘wet base’ conditions arise, it can lead to a dangerous cargo shift”
options: Yes, the whole body of the cargo can slide from side to side when the ship rolls with the water acting as low-friction lubricant
No, high moisture content only leads to the upper part of the cargo sloshing back and forth
No, only liquefaction of the top surface of the cargo causes cargo shift
Yes, the bottom of the cargo can move, leaving the higher parts unsupported
CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.answer: Yes, the whole body of the cargo can slide from side to side when the ship rolls with the water acting as low-friction lubricant

CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.question: Which ONE of the following best defines the term ‘cargo liquefaction’ in relation to solid bulk cargoes?
options: When the whole body of the cargo in a hold compacts during the voyage and the cargo starts to behave like a fluid.
When leaks of water through a hatch cover cause the cargo to become wet
When a Group C dry bulk cargo shifts due to excessive rolling angles
When a Group B dry bulk cargo shifts due to excessive rolling angles
CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.answer: When the whole body of the cargo in a hold compacts during the voyage and the cargo starts to behave like a fluid.

CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.question: Which ONE of the following is responsible for certifying the Transportable Moisture Limit and the actual moisture content of a cargo, or part cargo?
options: The cargo shipper
The ship’s agent
The charterer
The master
CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.answer: The cargo shipper

CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.question: Which ONE of the following is the maximum time that is allowed before loading that the declared moisture content can be measured by the shipper?
options: 7 days
5 days
2 weeks
10 days
CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.answer: 7 days

CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.question: Which ONE of the following best describes what happens to the moisture in a cargo when moisture migration takes place?
options: It moves down towards the bottom of the cargo stow
It moves up towards the surface of the cargo
It moves from side to side
It dries out naturally
CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.answer: It moves down towards the bottom of the cargo stow

CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.question: Which ONE of the following is responsible for issuing the cargo declaration if a cargo, offered for loading, is not shown in the IMSBC Code Appendices?
options: The Competent Authority
The ship owner
The ship manager
The shipper
CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.answer: The Competent Authority

CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.question: Which ONE of the following terms is the acronym ‘BCSN’ used for in relation to the IMSBC Code?
options: Bulk Cargo Shipping Name
Bulk Carrier Ship Number
Bulk Cargo Shipment Number
Bulk Cargo Statutory Name
CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.answer: Bulk Cargo Shipping Name

CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.question: Which one of the following most accurately identifies when cargo liquefaction can occur?
options: At any stage while the cargo is onboard
Only near to the end of the voyage
Only during heavy weather
After arrival at the discharge port
CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.answer: At any stage while the cargo is onboard

CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.question: Which ONE of the following most accurately describes when it is acceptable to load cargoes with a moisture content above the Transportable Moisture Limit (TML) on a normal bulk carrier?
options: It is never acceptable
Only if the moisture content is less than 5% above the TML
Only if the cargo has been previously carried without problems
Only if the forecast weather ‘en route’ is good
CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.answer: It is never acceptable

CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.question: Which ONE of the following is responsible for providing the Competent Authority with the cargo characteristics if a cargo, offered for loading, is not shown in the IMSBC Code Appendices?
options: The shipper
The master
The ship owner
The port authority
CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.answer: The shipper

CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.question: Which ONE of the following describes how the shipper should let the ship know the results of the moisture content tests of a dry bulk cargo?
options: They issue a signed certificate to the master
They inform the master by email
They tell the OOW on deck
They provide the information on completion of cargo loading.
CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.answer: They issue a signed certificate to the master

CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.question: If the moisture limits are exceeded in any cargo hold, once cargo loading has started, is the master allowed to suspend loading operations?
options: Yes
No
CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.answer: Yes

CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.question: Which ONE of the following correctly identifies how the master should be informed that the Competent Authority has approved the shipper’s test procedures?
options: He is given a document by the shipper or the Competent Authority stating that the procedures have been approved
The shipper tells him
The charterer tells him
The shipper gives him an email statement
CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.answer: He is given a document by the shipper or the Competent Authority stating that the procedures have been approved

CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.question: Which ONE of the following is the percentage of the Flow Moisture Point that is considered to be the Transportable Moisture Limit?
Which ONE of the following is the maximum moisture content that is considered safe for the carriage of IMSBC Group A bulk cargoes?
options: 100% of the Transportable Moisture Limit (TML)
90% of the Transportable Moisture Limit (TML)
75% of the Transportable Moisture Limit (TML)
100% of the Flow Moisture Point (FMP)
CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.answer: 100% of the Transportable Moisture Limit (TML)

CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.question: A cargo of 60,000 tonnes of nickel ore is for shipment. Which ONE of the following is the number of samples that should be taken by the shipper, according to the IMSBC Code?
The cargo is not listed in the IMSBC Code but consists of fine particles and appears to be damp or wet.^M^MCan it be safely loaded without testing for moisture content?
options: No
Yes
CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.answer: No

CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.question: Which ONE of the following statements is the most accurate in relation to a sample of IMSBC Group A cargo taken from a stockpile which appears to be dry?
options: It might be safe to load but the shipper’s declaration must be checked, to ensure the moisture content is below the declared TML
If it looks dry it is OK to load the cargo
If it also passes a can test it is OK to load the cargo
It might be safe to load but the shipper must be telephoned, to ensure the moisture content is OK before loading begins
CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.answer: It might be safe to load but the shipper’s declaration must be checked, to ensure the moisture content is below the declared TML

CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.question: Is the following statement always true?^M^M“When a can test shows no free fluid it means that the cargo is safe to load.”
options: No
Yes
CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.answer: No

CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.question: If no shipper’s declaration has been received, should cargo loading be allowed to start?
options: No
Yes
CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.answer: No

CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.question: Which ONE of the following cargo groups is subject to the IMSBC Code?
options: Solid bulk cargoes other than grain
Grain
Crude oil
Cargoes in intermediate bulk containers
CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.answer: Solid bulk cargoes other than grain

CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.question: Which ONE of the following identifies the cargo group(s) that a cargo that may liquefy belongs to, according to Appendix 1 of the IMSBC Code?
options: Group A
Group B
Group C
Group B and C
CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.answer: Group A

CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.question: Which ONE of the following actions is available to the master, before loading, to assess the moisture content of a cargo?
options: They can look at the cargo stockpile and, if it looks wet carry out ‘can tests’
They can take a sample from the cargo stockpile and look at it under bright light
They can take a sample from the cargo stockpile and heat it in a pan
They can ask which moisture test method was used
CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.answer: They can look at the cargo stockpile and, if it looks wet carry out ‘can tests’

CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.question: Which ONE of the following is correct if a cargo stockpile is sampled, and the Moisture Content (MC) is found to be uniform at 95% of the Flow Moisture Point (FMP)?
options: It is not safe to load the cargo because the MC is more than 90% of the FMP
It is always safe to load the cargo as the MC is less than the FMP
It will be safe to load the cargo, but only if the cargo looks dry
It will be safe to load the cargo, but only if it passes a ‘can test’
CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.answer: It is not safe to load the cargo because the MC is more than 90% of the FMP

CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.question: Which ONE of the following most accurately describes the action that should be taken where the ship’s master suspects that the various cargo stockpiles that are to be used for loading the ship may have varying moisture contents?
options: The master must insist that the shipper make a separate declaration for each stockpile or for the stockpile intended for each hold
No action is required as long as the average moisture content over the whole ship will be OK
Ensure that the cargo in each hold is mixed, so that the average moisture content is acceptable
The master should write a Note of Protest
CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.answer: The master must insist that the shipper make a separate declaration for each stockpile or for the stockpile intended for each hold

CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.question: Which ONE of the following identifies the most important result of cargo liquefaction?
options: Cargo shift leading to loss of stability
Difficulty in discharging the cargo
Blockage of bilge suctions
Risk of cargo damage
CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.answer: Cargo shift leading to loss of stability

CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.question: Which ONE of the following correctly identifies why loading should only be started after satisfactory declarations have been received from the shipper?
options: It is very difficult to unload wet cargo in the loading port once it has been loaded
If ‘wet’ cargo is loaded it will need to be mixed with some dry cargo to give an acceptable average moisture content in each hold
The shipper is responsible for loading the ship safely
The shipper is responsible for loading the ship within the charter party time limits
CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.answer: It is very difficult to unload wet cargo in the loading port once it has been loaded

CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.question: Which ONE of the following is the most accurate if the shipper declares that the moisture content is different at various places in the stockpiles of an IMSBC Group A cargo?
options: Only cargo which has a moisture content equal to or less than the TML can be safely loaded
Cargo from the various stockpiles can be mixed: provided the average moisture content in each hold is equal to or less than the TML
Cargo from the various stockpiles can be mixed: provided the average moisture content in the whole cargo is equal to or less than the TML
If the average moisture content in the various stockpiles is equal to or less than the TML then loading can safely go ahead
CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.answer: Only cargo which has a moisture content equal to or less than the TML can be safely loaded

CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.question: Is it acceptable to load cargo with a moisture content (MC) less than the Transportable Moisture Limit (TML) in some holds and cargo with a MC greater than the TML in other holds?
options: No, this is not correct
Yes, this is correct, so long as the MC is below the flow moisture point
Yes, this is correct, so long as the overall average MC is less than the TML
Yes, this is acceptable at any time
CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.answer: No, this is not correct

CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.question: Which ONE of these is the easiest way for the master to find out which test method was used to find the Transportable Moisture Limit (TML)?
options: The shipper has to provide the master with test certificates for the test method used to find the TML
The master can contact the Competent Authority in the loading port
The master can contact the Competent Authority in the discharge port
The ship’s agent can contact the shipper
CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.answer: The shipper has to provide the master with test certificates for the test method used to find the TML

CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.question: In which ONE of these books can you find detailed guidance on cargoes which may liquefy?
options: IMSBC Code
IMDG Code
ISM Code
FTP Code
CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.answer: IMSBC Code

CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.question: How many different test methods that can be used by the shipper for determining the Transportable Moisture Limit are identified in the IMSBC Code?
Which ONE of the following most accurately identifies when loading of a bulk cargo should be allowed to start?
options: After satisfactory written cargo declarations have been received from the shipper
When the shipper tells the master to start
Only when the weather conditions are dry
As soon as the hatches are open
CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.answer: After satisfactory written cargo declarations have been received from the shipper

CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.question: Which ONE of the following is the most likely consequence of cargo shift due to cargo liquefaction?
options: The ship heels to an angle of loll where she has little residual stability and a free surface in the cargo spaces
The ship heels, but remains stable
The ship trims by the stern
Structural damage to the hatch covers
CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.answer: The ship heels to an angle of loll where she has little residual stability and a free surface in the cargo spaces

CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.question: Which ONE of the following most accurately describes why cargo liquefaction causes loss of stability?
options: The liquefied cargo acts like a free surface, causing a virtual rise in the ship’s centre of gravity
The ship heels to small angle
The centre of gravity of the cargo stow gets higher
The centroid of the waterplane moves upwards
CD0341 — Liquefying cargoes.answer: The liquefied cargo acts like a free surface, causing a virtual rise in the ship’s centre of gravity

CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.question: Apart from rain, which ONE of these is the major cause of grain cargo wetness?
options: Ingress of sea water through leaky hatch covers
Ice and snow
Cargo sweat
Ship sweat
CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.answer: Ingress of sea water through leaky hatch covers

CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.question: Which of these best describes which ships are subject to the International Grain Code when carrying bulk grain? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: All ships regardless of size
Ships over 500 grt
Ships over 100 metres in length
Ships less than 75,000 dwt
CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.answer: All ships regardless of size

CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.question: Where can the Ship-Shore Safety Checklist for use by ships and grain loading terminals be found? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: The BLU Code.
The IMSBC Code Appendix 3
SOLAS documentation
The ship’s Loading Manual
CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.answer: The BLU Code.

CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.question: What action should be taken if insects, insect larvae, rats or mice, are seen, either dead or alive, at the time of loading grain? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: The master should stop loading, inform his owner and arrange for a surveyor to attend
Bury the infestation as much as possible
Try to remove the infestation as much as possible and continue loading
The master should have samples taken to show to the discharge terminal
CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.answer: The master should stop loading, inform his owner and arrange for a surveyor to attend

CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.question: How often should the hold bilges be sounded during a loaded voyage with an iron ore cargo? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: Every day
Every 12 hours
Every watch
Every week
CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.answer: Every day

CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.question: What is the typical angle of repose of a grain cargo? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: 5º

CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.question: What precautions should be taken when loading grain to avoid rain water affecting the cargo? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: Hatch covers should be closed on non-working hatches
Never load in rainy conditions
Arrange tarpaulins to keep off the rain
Ventilate the holds as much as possible between showers
CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.answer: Hatch covers should be closed on non-working hatches

CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.question: In addition to wetness, which ONE of these can make grain cargo self-heating more likely?
options: Stowage next to or above heated fuel tanks
Ventilation of the cargo
Tropical weather
Carbon monoxide
CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.answer: Stowage next to or above heated fuel tanks

CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.question: Why should hold bilge pumping records be kept while carrying iron ore cargoes? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: There may be disputes about differences between loaded and discharged cargo weights
To meet MARPOL requirements
To prove that the hold bilge pumps continue to work well
To enable stability calculations to be carried out prior to discharge
CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.answer: There may be disputes about differences between loaded and discharged cargo weights

CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.question: Which of these precautions must be taken before entering a hold that contains iron ore? Select the ONE best answer.
options: All aspects of the enclosed space entry must be complied with according to the SMS
Hold lighting should be switched on
The atmosphere should be checked for methane and carbon monoxide
The bridge OOW should be told
CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.answer: All aspects of the enclosed space entry must be complied with according to the SMS

CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.question: If infestation of a grain cargo is found at any inspection during the voyage or prior to arriving at the discharge berth what action should be taken? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: The master should inform his owners and arrange for expert advice on survey or fumigation
The master should urgently arrange for fumigation on arrival
The master should go alongside for discharge and hope that the infestation is not noticed
The master should get the crew to try to remove traces of the infestation
CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.answer: The master should inform his owners and arrange for expert advice on survey or fumigation

CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.question: Which IMSBC Code cargo group(s) does an iron ore cargo that may liquefy belong to? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: Group A
Group B
Group C
Groups A and C
CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.answer: Group A

CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.question: Which ONE of these is a hazard associated with cold-moulded Direct Reduced Iron (DRI)?
options: Self-heating and hydrogen gas fires
Explosion
Methane production
Liquefaction
CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.answer: Self-heating and hydrogen gas fires

CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.question: In the International Grain Code what does ‘specially suitable compartment’ mean? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: A hold that has longitudinal sloped topside tanks which are coincident with the hatch side girders
A hold that is clean enough to receive a grain cargo
A hold that is the correct size for the parcel of cargo to be loaded
A hold that can be easily cleaned after the cargo is discharged
CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.answer: A hold that has longitudinal sloped topside tanks which are coincident with the hatch side girders

CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.question: What is a ‘Document of Authorisation’? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: A document issued by the ship’s flag state certifying that the ship is capable of loading grain cargoes in accordance with the International Grain Code
A document required before discharge of grain cargo can proceed
A document issued by the ship’s flag state certifying that the ship meets the requirements of the Load Line Convention.
A document provided by the shipper to permit loading to commence
CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.answer: A document issued by the ship’s flag state certifying that the ship is capable of loading grain cargoes in accordance with the International Grain Code

CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.question: In the International Grain Code what does ‘filled compartment - trimmed’ mean? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: All of the spaces under the deck and hatches are filled as much as possible
The grain is trimmed to give an even angle of repose
The grain is trimmed to fill as much space as possible at the sides but not at the ends under the cross decks
The cargo is poured until it fills the hatch coamings
CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.answer: All of the spaces under the deck and hatches are filled as much as possible

CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.question: What is a typical stowage factor for wheat or corn? Select the ONE correct answer.
Which ONE of these contains details of cargoes that should be treated like grain, even though they are not grain?
options: The IMSBC Code, Appendix 3
The International Grain Code
MARPOL Annex V
SOLAS Chapter XII
CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.answer: The IMSBC Code, Appendix 3

CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.question: Does a ‘partly-filled compartment’ require to be over-stowed when a modern bulk carrier loads grain? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: Usually not, but the stability needs to be checked for acceptability
Never
Only in the centre holds
Always
CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.answer: Usually not, but the stability needs to be checked for acceptability

CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.question: How do the USA, Canada and Australia differ from the International Grain Code  requirements in respect of stability calculations? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: They differ in their treatment of untrimmed ends of holds
They differ in their treatment of down flooding angles
They assume a final heel angle of the ship of 15º
They have lower requirements than the International Grain Code
CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.answer: They differ in their treatment of untrimmed ends of holds

CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.question: Which ONE of these should the master do if self-heating is detected with smoke or heat?
options: Immediately contact the owners to get expert advice
Sail on to the discharge port to deal with the problem on arrival
Try to fight the fire immediately
Sail to a port of refuge and then contact the owner
CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.answer: Immediately contact the owners to get expert advice

CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.question: What is the maximum acceptable level of methane in the space above a coal cargo according to the IMSBC Code? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: 20% of the  LEL
70% of the LEL
90% of the LEL
5% of the LEL
CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.answer: 20% of the  LEL

CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.question: What does ‘LEL’ stand for? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: Lower Explosive Limit
Lower Environmental Limit
Light Emitting Lamp
Lower Energy Level
CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.answer: Lower Explosive Limit

CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.question: If self-heating has started which ONE action could cool the coal cargo?
options: Boundary cooling, if possible
The hatches can be opened slightly and fire-fighting water sprayed into the coal
Open the hatches to let the breeze cool the cargo
Natural ventilation of the coal surface
CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.answer: Boundary cooling, if possible

CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.question: How can the amount of methane in the space over a coal cargo be measured? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: Using an explosimeter
By smelling the gas
Litmus paper attached to a brass sounding rod
Using a wet and dry bulb thermometer
CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.answer: Using an explosimeter

CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.question: Which ONE of these can give rise to an explosion hazard in a coal cargo?
options: Hydrogen
Carbon dioxide
Nitrogen
Propane
CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.answer: Hydrogen

CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.question: Which ONE of these is likely to cause structural corrosion in a hold containing coal? Select the ONE answer that is the most likely.
options: Sulphuric acid
Formic acid
Nitric acid
Acetic acid
CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.answer: Sulphuric acid

CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.question: Which ONE of these gases typically causes an explosion risk with coal cargoes?
options: Methane
Oxygen
Propane
Nitrogen
CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.answer: Methane

CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.question: Which ONE of these is the percentage of methane in air that creates an explosion risk?
What concentration of carbon monoxide does the IMSBC Code say indicates a coal cargo is self-heating?
options: 50 ppm
80 ppm
100 ppm
10 ppm
CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.answer: 50 ppm

CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.question: What is the coal temperature above which the IMSBC Code says loading should not be allowed? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: 55ºC
100ºC
32ºC
25ºC
CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.answer: 55ºC

CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.question: Which ONE of these is given off when coal self-heats?
options: Carbon monoxide
Oxygen
Methane
Carbon dioxide
CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.answer: Carbon monoxide

CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.question: Which ONE of these is given off when corrosive acids are formed in a coal cargo?
options: Hydrogen
Carbon monoxide
Methane
Oxygen
CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.answer: Hydrogen

CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.question: Using temperature measuring ports or pipes, at how many levels should temperature monitoring be done? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: At 2 or 3 levels
Only at the surface
Only at the lowest level
At the lowest and mid-levels only
CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.answer: At 2 or 3 levels

CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.question: Where can the master find information on coal cargoes and their hazards? Select ONE correct answer.
options: The IMSBC Code
The International Grain Code
The ISM Code
The internet
CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.answer: The IMSBC Code

CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.question: What does an ‘explosimeter’ measure? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: The amount of methane as a percentage of the methane LEL
The likelihood of an explosion as a percentage
The percentage of methane in the air
The amount of air as a percentage of the methane LEL
CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.answer: The amount of methane as a percentage of the methane LEL

CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.question: When should coal cargo temperatures be taken? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: Prior to loading and during loading
On completion of loading
After the hatches are closed
There is no requirement to take the cargo temperature
CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.answer: Prior to loading and during loading

CD0342 — Common bulk cargoes.question: For how long should hold ventilation be shut down before gas monitoring measurements are taken? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: 4 hours
