CD0344 — Loading bulk carriers.question: Which ONE of these options is NOT shown on a Certificate of Fitness to proceed to sea? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: Dock water density
The quantity of cargo loaded
The method(s) of cargo securing
Cargo precautions to be taken during the voyage
CD0344 — Loading bulk carriers.answer: Dock water density

CD0344 — Loading bulk carriers.question: For cargo trimming purposes, how are bulk cargoes categorised? Select the ONE best answer.
options: Cohesive and non-cohesive
Free-flowing and compact
Hazardous and non-hazardous
By density
CD0344 — Loading bulk carriers.answer: Cohesive and non-cohesive

CD0344 — Loading bulk carriers.question: If a bulk cargo is prone to liquefaction, what information in addition to the normal cargo declaration, must shippers provide to Masters of ships over 150m in length? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: The cargo density
The method of testing the cargo for moisture content
The name of the Competent Authority at the load port
A letter guaranteeing that the cargo will not liquefy
CD0344 — Loading bulk carriers.answer: The cargo density

CD0344 — Loading bulk carriers.question: Who is responsible for issuing a ship with a Document of Authorisation for the carriage of grain? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: The ship's flag State
The shipper
Surveyors representing charterers
Surveyors representing the ship's P&I Club
CD0344 — Loading bulk carriers.answer: The ship's flag State

CD0344 — Loading bulk carriers.question: Which ONE of these stability criteria is necessary for a ship to depart from the load berth on an even keel? Select the ONE best answer.
options: The longitudinal centres of gravity and buoyancy must be equal
The longitudinal centre of gravity must be more than the longitudinal centre of buoyancy
The longitudinal centre of gravity must be less than the longitudinal centre of buoyancy
The longitudinal centre of gravity must be midships
CD0344 — Loading bulk carriers.answer: The longitudinal centres of gravity and buoyancy must be equal

CD0344 — Loading bulk carriers.question: When will a marine authority issue the Master with a Certificate of Readiness to Load? Select the ONE best answer.
options: After an inspection of cargo spaces has been satisfactorily carried out and pre-loading calculations checked
After the Master has issued Notice of Readiness (NOR)
After the initial draught survey has been carried out
When the terminal representative is satisfied that the ship is cargo-worthy
CD0344 — Loading bulk carriers.answer: After an inspection of cargo spaces has been satisfactorily carried out and pre-loading calculations checked

CD0344 — Loading bulk carriers.question: With regard to draught surveys, which ONE of the following statement is correct? Select the ONE best answer.
options: Accurate draught readings must be taken forward, aft and amidships on both sides of the ship
Displacement corrections for heel need not be applied
When the ship is trimmed beyond the limits specified in tank sounding tables, corrections to the soundings can be applied by extrapolation
The observed draught readings are directly used in the calculations
CD0344 — Loading bulk carriers.answer: Accurate draught readings must be taken forward, aft and amidships on both sides of the ship

CD0344 — Loading bulk carriers.question: What does a permanent equilateral triangle, marked amidships on both sides of a ship, indicate? Select the ONE best answer.
options: Certain cargo restrictions have been imposed upon the ship
The ship has been granted alternative tonnages
The ship maintains a greater-than-minimum freeboard in all conditions of loading
The ship is certified for alternate hold loading
CD0344 — Loading bulk carriers.answer: Certain cargo restrictions have been imposed upon the ship

CD0344 — Loading bulk carriers.question: Where can information on trimming requirements for a bulk cargo with an angle of repose greater than 30 degrees be found? Select the ONE best answer.
options: In the I.M.S.B.C. Code
In SOLAS
In the ship's loading manual
In the BLU manual
CD0344 — Loading bulk carriers.answer: In the I.M.S.B.C. Code

CD0344 — Loading bulk carriers.question: What should the Master do if the shipper’s cargo declaration has not been received? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: Await the shipper's declaration before commencing cargo loading operations
Commence loading cargo
Inform the shipper that the cargo declaration must be provided before the ship departs from the load berth
Seek approval to load cargo from the ship's classification society
CD0344 — Loading bulk carriers.answer: Await the shipper's declaration before commencing cargo loading operations

CD0344 — Loading bulk carriers.question: What is the consequence of the Master of a time-chartered ship issuing Notice of Readiness (NOR) but the ship not being able to receive cargo due to the holds being dirty? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: The ship can be taken off the berth and placed 'off-hire'
The ship will be deemed unseaworthy
The ship will be detained by port-state control
The ship can withdraw the NOR
CD0344 — Loading bulk carriers.answer: The ship can be taken off the berth and placed 'off-hire'

CD0344 — Loading bulk carriers.question: The quantity of cargo to be loaded, obtained by dividing the capacity of cargo holds by the Stowage Factor, exceeds the maximum summer deadweight of the ship. What does this mean? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: The ship will reach its summer draught before the cargo holds are full
The ship will reach its summer draught when cargo holds are full
Shear Forces will be exceeded in the still water condition
Bending Moments will be exceeded in the still water condition
CD0344 — Loading bulk carriers.answer: The ship will reach its summer draught before the cargo holds are full

CD0344 — Loading bulk carriers.question: What action should be taken by the Master or Chief Officer if deviations from the agreed load plan are detected? Select the ONE best answer.
options: Adjust cargo or ballast operations, or both, to correct the deviations and inform the terminal
Only ballast operations should be adjusted
Contact the shipper and seek clarification
Make appropriate entries in the log book
CD0344 — Loading bulk carriers.answer: Adjust cargo or ballast operations, or both, to correct the deviations and inform the terminal

CD0344 — Loading bulk carriers.question: What method is used to accurately measure the quantity of cargo loaded? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: The draught survey
The load line survey
A weighbridge survey
Tallying the number of grab loads
CD0344 — Loading bulk carriers.answer: The draught survey

CD0344 — Loading bulk carriers.question: Why is it important for the terminal to supply the Master in advance with the water density at the load berth? Select the ONE best answer.
options: For accurate stability calculations to be made before the loading plan is finalised
For accurate stability calculations to be made before the commencement of cargo loading operations
For calculations to be made during the initial draught survey
For calculations to be made during the final draught survey
CD0344 — Loading bulk carriers.answer: For accurate stability calculations to be made before the loading plan is finalised

CD0344 — Loading bulk carriers.question: For a ship arriving in ballast, why does a shore terminal need to supply information on the depth of water at the berth? Select the ONE best answer.
options: Because this information is required when deciding how much cargo the ship can load
So that the ship can calculate how to distribute cargo in order to complete loading on an even keel
So that the ship can make adjustments for air draught
To minimise the effects of squat
CD0344 — Loading bulk carriers.answer: Because this information is required when deciding how much cargo the ship can load

CD0344 — Loading bulk carriers.question: The ship is to load a low density bulk cargo. How can the approximate quantity of cargo that can be carried in a particular hold be determined? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: By proportioning the cargo hold capacity to the ship’s total cargo hold cubic capacity and applying that to the quantity of cargo to be loaded
By comparing the load density of the cargo hold with the cargo stowage factor
CD0344 — Loading bulk carriers.answer: By proportioning the cargo hold capacity to the ship’s total cargo hold cubic capacity and applying that to the quantity of cargo to be loaded

CD0344 — Loading bulk carriers.question: What might happen if a ship does not request advance information about a terminal where cargo is to be loaded? Select the ONE best answer.
options: There could be a long delay between the time of berthing and commencement of cargo loading operations
The ship will be placed 'off-hire'
The ship could run aground in the approaches to the berth
The ship will not be allowed to enter the port
CD0344 — Loading bulk carriers.answer: There could be a long delay between the time of berthing and commencement of cargo loading operations

CD0344 — Loading bulk carriers.question: Which ONE of the following is NOT acceptable during cargo loading operations? Select the ONE best answer.
options: Loading cargo high against one bulkhead and low against the opposite bulkhead in any one cargo hold
Loading cargo high against both bulkheads in any one cargo hold
Distributing cargoes evenly
Trimming cargoes to the boundaries of each cargo space
CD0344 — Loading bulk carriers.answer: Loading cargo high against one bulkhead and low against the opposite bulkhead in any one cargo hold

CD0344 — Loading bulk carriers.question: Why must tidal information be included in the ship-shore safety checklist? Select the ONE best answer.
options: For the Master to know water depths at the berth and its approaches especially when un-berthing in an emergency
Because it is mandatory under SOLAS
Because it is mandatory under the I.M.S.B.C. Code
For moorings to be tended accordingly
CD0344 — Loading bulk carriers.answer: For the Master to know water depths at the berth and its approaches especially when un-berthing in an emergency

CD0344 — Loading bulk carriers.question: What should the Master do if advised by the shore terminal that cargo with a moisture content in excess of the Transportable Moisture Limit is to be loaded? Select the ONE best answer.
options: The Master would have to demonstrate to the flag-State adequate residual stability in case of cargo shifting and adequate structural integrity for additional stresses
The Master should never refuse to load if the ship is specially constructed for such cargoes
The Master should never refuse to load under any circumstances
The Master would have to start loading, but monitor and record the moisture content at regular intervals
CD0344 — Loading bulk carriers.answer: The Master would have to demonstrate to the flag-State adequate residual stability in case of cargo shifting and adequate structural integrity for additional stresses

CD0344 — Loading bulk carriers.question: A ship’s draughts are: 7.2m forward; 8.6m aft; 7.8m midships. Is the ship hogged or sagged? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: Hogged
Sagged
CD0344 — Loading bulk carriers.answer: Hogged

CD0345 — Hull structural strength.question: Which of the following most accurately describes a disadvantage of High Tensile Steel used in ship structures? Select the ONE best answer
options: When corrosion occurs, the rate of loss of strength is more than for ordinary mild steel
It is more expensive
It is heavier than mild steel
It is more prone to corrosion
CD0345 — Hull structural strength.answer: When corrosion occurs, the rate of loss of strength is more than for ordinary mild steel

CD0345 — Hull structural strength.question: Which ONE of the following statements about the strength of the hull is most accurate?
options: Factors such as operation in rough weather and damage from cargo work can greatly reduce the strength of the hull
The strength of the ship never changes much after the building stage
The strength of the ship always decreases rapidly in service
Incidental damage from cargo work has no effect on the strength of the hull
CD0345 — Hull structural strength.answer: Factors such as operation in rough weather and damage from cargo work can greatly reduce the strength of the hull

CD0345 — Hull structural strength.question: With respect to flat bar cross sections of stiffeners used for the ship’s hull, which ONE of the following statements is most accurate?
options: Flat bar is relatively poor at resisting buckling
Flat bar is relatively good at resisting buckling
Flat bar is relatively expensive to make
Flat bar is difficult to apply a protective coating to
CD0345 — Hull structural strength.answer: Flat bar is relatively poor at resisting buckling

CD0345 — Hull structural strength.question: What restrictions are usually placed on holds carrying water ballast? Select the ONE best answer
options: Holds must not be filled to between 20% and 90% capacity
Holds must be filled to between 20% and 90% of capacity
Holds must be filled to approximately 60% at all times
Holds should always be filled to 70% capacity
CD0345 — Hull structural strength.answer: Holds must not be filled to between 20% and 90% capacity

CD0345 — Hull structural strength.question: Which ONE of the following statements about corrosion is most accurate?
options: Corrosion can greatly reduce the strength of the ship
Corrosion of the hull is relatively unimportant, as there is an allowance for this at the design stage
The strength of the hull always decreases rapidly in service
No permanent loss of hull strength occurs because of operation in heavy weather
CD0345 — Hull structural strength.answer: Corrosion can greatly reduce the strength of the ship

CD0345 — Hull structural strength.question: Which ONE of the following statements about bending of the hull is most accurate?
options: When the hull is hogging, the deck will be in tension whilst the keel will be in compression
When the hull is hogging, the deck will be in compression whilst the keel will be in tension
When the hull is sagging, the deck will be under tension whilst the keel will be in compression
When the hull is sagging, the deck and keel will be under tension
CD0345 — Hull structural strength.answer: When the hull is hogging, the deck will be in tension whilst the keel will be in compression

CD0345 — Hull structural strength.question: When the distance between wave crests is equal to the length of the ship’s hull, which ONE of the following statements is most accurate?
options: When the wave crests are fore and aft, they will make the ship tend to sag
The smallest bending moment caused by the wave motion will be when either the peak or the trough of the wave is at mid-ships
When the wave crests are fore and aft, they will make the ship tend to hog
There will be no overall effect on the hull
CD0345 — Hull structural strength.answer: When the wave crests are fore and aft, they will make the ship tend to sag

CD0345 — Hull structural strength.question: With respect to the ship’s hull, which ONE of the following statements is most accurate?
options: Longitudinal framing tends to be used for longer vessels
Transverse framing tends to be used for longer vessels
Longitudinal and transverse framing should never be used on the same ship
Longitudinal framing cannot resist bending stresses
CD0345 — Hull structural strength.answer: Longitudinal framing tends to be used for longer vessels

CD0345 — Hull structural strength.question: With respect to the cross sections of stiffeners used for the ship’s hull, which ONE of the following statements is most accurate?
options: T-profile performs better in most situations
Angle bar performs better in most situations
Flat bar performs better in most situations
It is difficult to apply protective coatings to Bulb profiles
CD0345 — Hull structural strength.answer: T-profile performs better in most situations

CD0345 — Hull structural strength.question: With reference to shear forces on a ship’s hull, which ONE of the following statements is most accurate?
options: Shear forces cause further stress on the hull in addition to that caused by bending
Shear forces are not significant compared to the stress on the hull caused by bending
Shear forces cancel out some of the stress on the hull caused by bending
Shear stress always opposes the stress on the hull caused by bending
CD0345 — Hull structural strength.answer: Shear forces cause further stress on the hull in addition to that caused by bending

CD0345 — Hull structural strength.question: With reference to the stress distribution of a ship’s hull subjected to bending, which ONE of the following statements is most accurate?
options: The bending stresses will be maximum at the deck and bottom plating and reduce towards the neutral axis at approximately the mid-point of the side plating
The bending stresses will be zero at the deck and bottom plating and increase towards the neutral axis at approximately the mid-point of the side plating
The bending stresses will be equal at the deck, bottom plating and the neutral axis at approximately the mid-point of the side plating
The bending stresses will be maximum at the deck plating and reduce to zero at the bottom plating
CD0345 — Hull structural strength.answer: The bending stresses will be maximum at the deck and bottom plating and reduce towards the neutral axis at approximately the mid-point of the side plating

CD0345 — Hull structural strength.question: Which ONE of the following statements about hull strength is most accurate?
options: A ship regularly operating in heavy weather is subject to many stress reversals which lower the strength of the hull
A ship regularly operating in heavy weather will remain as strong as when new if properly maintained
Fatigue cracking is never related to corrosion
Small Fatigue cracks will normally be okay until the next dry-dock or survey
CD0345 — Hull structural strength.answer: A ship regularly operating in heavy weather is subject to many stress reversals which lower the strength of the hull

CD0345 — Hull structural strength.question: With reference to the hull structure, which ONE of the following statements is most accurate?
options: Fatigue is the reduction in strength of a material due to repeated cycles of stress
Fatigue cracking is most likely when the ship is new
Fatigue is the reduction in strength of a material due to constant high load
If protective coatings are maintained, fatigue will never affect a ship
CD0345 — Hull structural strength.answer: Fatigue is the reduction in strength of a material due to repeated cycles of stress

CD0345 — Hull structural strength.question: With reference to the stress distribution along the length of a ship’s hull subjected to bending, which ONE of the following statements is most accurate?
options: If the ship is evenly loaded, the bending stresses are at a maximum at mid-length
If the ship is evenly loaded, the bending stresses are at a maximum fore and aft
If the ship is evenly loaded, the bending stresses are equal along the length of the ship
If the ship is evenly loaded, the bending stresses are at a minimum at mid-length
CD0345 — Hull structural strength.answer: If the ship is evenly loaded, the bending stresses are at a maximum at mid-length

CD0345 — Hull structural strength.question: With reference to water on the deck of a ship, which ONE of the following statements is most accurate?
options: Sea water coming over the deck will cause downward forces on the ship’s structure and is most likely to affect the fore end of the vessel
Sea water coming over the deck will cause downward forces on the ship’s structure and is most likely to affect the aft end of the vessel
Sea water coming over the deck causes additional buoyancy forces on the ship’s structure
Sea water coming over the deck has little overall effect on large vessels
CD0345 — Hull structural strength.answer: Sea water coming over the deck will cause downward forces on the ship’s structure and is most likely to affect the fore end of the vessel

CD0345 — Hull structural strength.question: With regard to looking for defects in the hull structure, which ONE of the following statements is most accurate?
options: Connections between parts of the structure, or changes of section, are common areas to find defects
Connections between parts of the structure are so strong that they rarely fail
Small cracks in shell plating above the waterline are of no concern
Loss of protective coating above welds is fairly common and of no immediate concern
CD0345 — Hull structural strength.answer: Connections between parts of the structure, or changes of section, are common areas to find defects

CD0345 — Hull structural strength.question: With reference to cracking of the hull structure, which ONE of the following statements is most accurate?
options: Cracks occur when the material can no longer withstand tensile forces
Cracks occur when the material can no longer withstand compressive forces
Corrosion does not affect whether or not cracks occur
Fatigue does not affect whether or not cracks occur
CD0345 — Hull structural strength.answer: Cracks occur when the material can no longer withstand tensile forces

CD0345 — Hull structural strength.question: With respect to the ship’s hull, which ONE of the following statements is most accurate?
options: The main purpose of the longitudinal stiffeners is to resist bending
Longitudinal stiffeners are only used in shorter vessels
Longitudinal stiffeners are only used in longer vessels
The main purpose of the transverse frames is to support the deck structure
CD0345 — Hull structural strength.answer: The main purpose of the longitudinal stiffeners is to resist bending

CD0345 — Hull structural strength.question: With regard to shear forces acting on the hull, which ONE of the following statements is most accurate?
options: Shear force is created when there are two parallel, opposite forces, like gravity and buoyancy
Shear force is created when there are two parallel forces in the same direction, like gravity and buoyancy
Shear force refers to the horizontal force at the forward part of the vessel
Shear force refers to the horizontal force at the aft part of the vessel
CD0345 — Hull structural strength.answer: Shear force is created when there are two parallel, opposite forces, like gravity and buoyancy

CD0345 — Hull structural strength.question: With reference to crack formation in the hull structure, which ONE of the following statements is most accurate?
options: Cracks can occur due to fatigue, corrosion, or sharp changes of section
Cracks occur when the material can no longer withstand compressive forces
Small cracks often occur and are not a significant problem
Cracks in hatch coamings are not a significant problem
CD0345 — Hull structural strength.answer: Cracks can occur due to fatigue, corrosion, or sharp changes of section

CD0345 — Hull structural strength.question: With reference to looking for defects in the hull structure, which ONE of the following statements is most accurate?
options: Indentations in the side and floor plating of Bulk carriers from cargo work can lead to corrosion and cracking
Indentations in the side and floor plating of Bulk carriers from cargo work are usually of no great importance
Large hatch openings on container and bulk vessels do not form part of the structure and therefore do not need close inspection
Double bottom tanks are not usually subject to corrosion
CD0345 — Hull structural strength.answer: Indentations in the side and floor plating of Bulk carriers from cargo work can lead to corrosion and cracking

CD0345 — Hull structural strength.question: Which ONE of the following statements about forces on the ship’s hull is most accurate?
options: Panting is the in and out movement of the shell plating due to the variation in water pressure on the shell plating.
Pounding is most likely to occur when the ship is fully loaded
Panting occurs when the vessel is lifted by the sea and then slams back down on the water
Pounding damage is most likely at mid-ships
CD0345 — Hull structural strength.answer: Panting is the in and out movement of the shell plating due to the variation in water pressure on the shell plating.

CD0345 — Hull structural strength.question: With respect to rolling causing stress on the ship’s hull, which ONE of the following statements is most accurate?
options: Rolling mostly causes stresses in the transverse bulkheads
Rolling mostly causes stresses at the forward part of the ship
Rolling mostly causes stresses at the aft part of the ship
Rolling mostly causes stresses in the longitudinal stiffeners
CD0345 — Hull structural strength.answer: Rolling mostly causes stresses in the transverse bulkheads

CD0345 — Hull structural strength.question: Which ONE of the following statements about the loads on the hull is most accurate?
options: Reducing the dynamic loads on the hull by slowing down or altering course in heavy weather is effective in both increasing safety and maintaining the strength of the vessel
Little can be done in heavy weather to reduce the dynamic loads on the hull
Static loads on the hull can be reduced by slowing down or altering course
Reducing the dynamic loads on the hull by slowing down or altering course in heavy weather should only be considered in an emergency for safety reasons
CD0345 — Hull structural strength.answer: Reducing the dynamic loads on the hull by slowing down or altering course in heavy weather is effective in both increasing safety and maintaining the strength of the vessel

CD0345 — Hull structural strength.question: For a loaded, simply supported symmetrical beam which ONE of the following statements about the resulting bending stresses is most accurate?
options: If the beam is symmetrical, the bending stresses are highest at the outside surfaces and zero along the neutral axis
If the beam is symmetrical, the bending stresses are zero at the outside surfaces and highest along the neutral axis
If the beam is symmetrical, the bending stresses are the same throughout any cross-section of the beam
If the beam is symmetrical, the bending stresses are zero throughout any cross-section of the beam
CD0345 — Hull structural strength.answer: If the beam is symmetrical, the bending stresses are highest at the outside surfaces and zero along the neutral axis

CD0345 — Hull structural strength.question: Which ONE of the following statements about forces on the hull is most accurate?
options: Shear forces on the hull will tend to be high if one hold is fully loaded and the next is empty
Shear forces on the hull will tend to be high if all holds are evenly loaded
Shear forces on the hull will tend to be high if all holds are empty
Shear forces on the hull will tend to be low if one hold is fully loaded and the next is empty
CD0345 — Hull structural strength.answer: Shear forces on the hull will tend to be high if one hold is fully loaded and the next is empty

CD0345 — Hull structural strength.question: With reference to looking for defects in the hull structure around hatch openings, which ONE of the following statements is most accurate?
options: The hatch corners and hatch coaming brackets need close attention as they are prone to cracking
The deck plating midway along the length of the hatch needs close attention as it is prone to cracking
The deck plating midway along the breadth of the hatch needs close attention as it is prone to cracking
Hatch openings do not form part of the structure and therefore do not need close inspection
CD0345 — Hull structural strength.answer: The hatch corners and hatch coaming brackets need close attention as they are prone to cracking

CD0345 — Hull structural strength.question: With reference to the hull structure, which ONE of the following statements is most accurate?
options: Resistance to buckling depends on the length and cross section of the stiffener or girder
Resistance to buckling depends only on the length of the stiffener or girder
Resistance to buckling depends only on the cross section of the stiffener or girder
Buckling can occur in tension or compression
CD0345 — Hull structural strength.answer: Resistance to buckling depends on the length and cross section of the stiffener or girder

CD0345 — Hull structural strength.question: With reference to static and dynamic forces acting on the hull, which ONE of the following statements is most accurate?
options: High static forces, for instance due to poor cargo loading, mean that the vessel is less safe when operating in heavy weather
Provided the maximum static loading for the hull has not been exceeded, the vessel should be safe in any weather conditions
Dynamic loads on the vessel are insignificant compared to the weight of cargo and ballast
Static forces on the vessel are insignificant compared to sea forces
CD0345 — Hull structural strength.answer: High static forces, for instance due to poor cargo loading, mean that the vessel is less safe when operating in heavy weather

CD0345 — Hull structural strength.question: With respect to bending stresses on the ship’s hull, which ONE of the following statements is most accurate?
options: Bending stresses will normally be highest at mid length and at the deck and bottom plating levels
Bending stresses will normally be highest fore and aft and at the deck and bottom plating levels
Bending stresses will normally be highest at mid length and half way between the deck and bottom plating levels
Bending stresses will normally be highest in way of the engine room and half way between the deck and bottom plating levels
CD0345 — Hull structural strength.answer: Bending stresses will normally be highest at mid length and at the deck and bottom plating levels

CD0345 — Hull structural strength.question: For a loaded, simply supported beam which ONE of the following statements about compressive and tensile forces is most accurate?
options: The load side is under compression and the opposite side is under tension
The load side is under tension and the opposite side is under compression
Both the load side and the opposite side are under tension
Both the load side and the opposite side are under compression
CD0345 — Hull structural strength.answer: The load side is under compression and the opposite side is under tension

CD0345 — Hull structural strength.question: With respect to framing types for the ship’s hull, which ONE of the following statements is most accurate?
options: Combination framing uses both transverse and longitudinal framing
Combination framing uses transverse frames and box girders
Combination framing uses longitudinal frames and box girders
Combination framing is required on all new oil tankers
CD0345 — Hull structural strength.answer: Combination framing uses both transverse and longitudinal framing

CD0345 — Hull structural strength.question: With reference to stiffening of side shell plating, which ONE of the following statements is most accurate?
options: The middle and ends of stiffeners and girders will be subject to the highest bending stress
The middle and ends of stiffeners and girders will be subject to zero bending stress
Bending stress is equal along the entire length of stiffeners and girders
The ends of stiffeners and girders will be subject to zero bending stress
CD0345 — Hull structural strength.answer: The middle and ends of stiffeners and girders will be subject to the highest bending stress

CD0345 — Hull structural strength.question: Which ONE of the following statements about hull inspections is most accurate?
options: Ship’s crew should regularly inspect the cargo holds, hatch covers and ballast tanks with a view to detecting damage and defects
Ship’s crew are not allowed to inspect the cargo holds, hatch covers and ballast tanks
There is no need to detect damage and defects between surveys
Ship’s crew have insufficient training to inspect the cargo holds, hatch covers and ballast tanks with a view to detecting damage and defects.
CD0345 — Hull structural strength.answer: Ship’s crew should regularly inspect the cargo holds, hatch covers and ballast tanks with a view to detecting damage and defects

CD0345 — Hull structural strength.question: With reference to the forces acting on the hull, which ONE of the following statements is most accurate?
options: Panting, pounding, and sloshing of liquids in tanks are examples of dynamic forces
Static forces tend to cancel out dynamic forces
The weight of fuel, cargo, fresh water and ballast are examples of dynamic forces
Dynamic forces are always small compared to static forces
CD0345 — Hull structural strength.answer: Panting, pounding, and sloshing of liquids in tanks are examples of dynamic forces

CD0345 — Hull structural strength.question: For a loaded, simply supported beam with uneven loading, which ONE of the following statements about the loading of the supports is most accurate?
options: If the loading is uneven, the support nearest to the load has the greatest force
If the loading is uneven, the support furthest from the load has the greatest force
Even if the loading is uneven, each support carries equal force
Even if the loading is uneven, the reactions at each support will be zero.
CD0345 — Hull structural strength.answer: If the loading is uneven, the support nearest to the load has the greatest force

CD0345 — Hull structural strength.question: For an evenly loaded, simply supported beam which ONE of the following statements about the bending stress is most accurate?
options: The bending stress is greatest half way along the length of the beam
The ends of the beam cannot move
The bending stress is greatest at each end
The bending stress is zero half way along the length of the beam
CD0345 — Hull structural strength.answer: The bending stress is greatest half way along the length of the beam

CD0345 — Hull structural strength.question: Which ONE of the following statements about sloshing of fluid in tanks is most accurate?
options: Excessive forces from fluids sloshing in tanks can be prevented by not having them between 20% and 90% full
Excessive forces from fluids sloshing in tanks can be prevented by having them between 20% and 90% full
Excessive forces from fluids sloshing in tanks can only be prevented by  having them completely full
Excessive forces from fluids sloshing in tanks can be prevented by having them only half full
CD0345 — Hull structural strength.answer: Excessive forces from fluids sloshing in tanks can be prevented by not having them between 20% and 90% full

CD0345 — Hull structural strength.question: Which ONE of these IMO publications requires that Bulk Carriers have a loading plan?
options: SOLAS
COLREG
Load line
MARPOL
CD0345 — Hull structural strength.answer: SOLAS

CD0345 — Hull structural strength.question: When is it safe to load the tank top with more than the maximum given in the Capacity Plan? Select the ONE correct answer
options: Never
If the cargo has a low stowage factor
If the cargo is trimmed to give a level surface after loading is complete
If the forecast weather conditions on voyage are good
CD0345 — Hull structural strength.answer: Never

CD0345 — Hull structural strength.question: Which one of the following best describes why bulk carriers are more prone to corrosion than tankers or container ships? Select the ONE best answer.
options: Bulk carriers suffer much more mechanical damage to coatings due to grab damage and other impacts during loading and discharging
They spend more time in port
Tankers and container ships have higher technology coating systems applied to their cargo carrying spaces
Bulk carriers are built of lower grades of steel
CD0345 — Hull structural strength.answer: Bulk carriers suffer much more mechanical damage to coatings due to grab damage and other impacts during loading and discharging

CD0345 — Hull structural strength.question: What does the abbreviation PMA stand for? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: Permanent Means of Access
Port marine Authority
Post-Mooring Activities
Port marine Agencies
CD0345 — Hull structural strength.answer: Permanent Means of Access

CD0358 — SOPEP, Your role.question: When does an oil spill become oil pollution? Select the BEST answer.

A plan held on board as a precautionary measure.
A plan to use if assisting another vessel with a clean up.

When they join a vessel, they will be instructed by a senior officer.

CD0358 — SOPEP, Your role.answer: They will be briefed for it and it may also be shown on the muster list.

Because the crew cannot be trusted to do it themselves.
CD0358 — SOPEP, Your role.answer: They ensure that planned procedures will work.

A casual attitude.

CD0387 — Enclosed space entry, Hazard aw.question: Quelle est la mesure maximum acceptable pour les gaz inflammables avant d'entrer dans un espace clos ? Sélectionnez LA réponse correcte.
options: Jusqu'à 1 % de la limite inférieure d'inflammabilité.
Jusqu'à la limite inférieure d'inflammabilité.
Jusqu'à une concentration de 1 % par volume.
Jusqu'à 50 % de la limite inférieure d'inflammabilité.
CD0387 — Enclosed space entry, Hazard aw.answer: Jusqu'à 1 % de la limite inférieure d'inflammabilité.

CD0387 — Enclosed space entry, Hazard aw.question: 밀폐 공간에 진입하기 전 가연성 가스 측정기의 최대 수락 가능 판독치는 얼마입니까? 올바른 답을 하나 선택하십시오.
options: 가연성 가스 하한의 최대 1%.
최저 가연성 가스 하한.
최대 1% 농도 부피.
가연성 가스 하한의 최대 50%.
CD0387 — Enclosed space entry, Hazard aw.answer: 가연성 가스 하한의 최대 1%.

CD0387 — Enclosed space entry, Hazard aw.question: According to this module, who should sign a permit to work for an enclosed space? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: A responsible person and the worker in charge of the task.
The person who did the risk assessment.
All those involved in the work.
The ship’s safety officer.
CD0387 — Enclosed space entry, Hazard aw.answer: A responsible person and the worker in charge of the task.

CD0387 — Enclosed space entry, Hazard aw.question: 根据本模块的内容，应该由谁来签署密闭空间作业许可证？ 请选择一个正确答案。
options: 负责人和负责任务的作业人员。
执行风险评估的人员。
所有参与作业的人员。
船舶安全官员。
CD0387 — Enclosed space entry, Hazard aw.answer: 负责人和负责任务的作业人员。

CD0387 — Enclosed space entry, Hazard aw.question: Según este módulo, ¿quién debe firmar el permiso para trabajar en un espacio cerrado? Seleccione la ÚNICA respuesta correcta.
options: Una persona responsable y el trabajador encargado de la tarea.
La persona encargada de la evaluación de riesgos.
Todas las personas implicadas en el trabajo.
El responsable de seguridad del buque.
CD0387 — Enclosed space entry, Hazard aw.answer: Una persona responsable y el trabajador encargado de la tarea.

CD0387 — Enclosed space entry, Hazard aw.question: Selon ce module, qui doit signer un permis pour travailler en espace clos ? Sélectionnez LA réponse correcte.
options: Une personne responsable et le travailleur en charge de la tâche.
La personne qui procède à l'évaluation des risques.
Toutes les personnes impliquées dans la tâche.
Le responsable de la sécurité sur le navire.
CD0387 — Enclosed space entry, Hazard aw.answer: Une personne responsable et le travailleur en charge de la tâche.

CD0387 — Enclosed space entry, Hazard aw.question: 이 모듈에 따르면 누가 밀폐 공가 작업 승인서에 서명해야 합니까? 올바른 답을 하나 선택하십시오.
options: 책임자 및 작업 담당 작업자.
위험 평가를 실시한 사람.
작업에 관련된 모든 봉사.
선박 안전 담당자.
CD0387 — Enclosed space entry, Hazard aw.answer: 책임자 및 작업 담당 작업자.

CD0387 — Enclosed space entry, Hazard aw.question: Why do we need to know what cargoes have previously been carried in a cargo space before entering it, or any space next to it? Select the ONE best answer.
options: Because we need to know which toxic substances may be present so that we can test for them.
Because we need to know which flammable substances may be present so that we can test for them.
Because we need to know which oxygen depleting substances may be present so that we can test for them.
We don’t, provided we use a personal gas monitor.
CD0387 — Enclosed space entry, Hazard aw.answer: Because we need to know which toxic substances may be present so that we can test for them.

CD0387 — Enclosed space entry, Hazard aw.question: 进入某个货物空间之前或旁边的任何空间之前，为什么需要知道之前承载的是什么货物？ 请选择一个最佳答案。
options: 因为我们需要知道可能存在什么有毒物质，以便可以进行测试。
因为我们需要知道可能存在什么可燃物质，以便可以进行测试。
因为我们需要知道可能存在什么氧气消耗物质，以便可以进行测试。
不用知道，因为我们使用个人气体监测仪。
CD0387 — Enclosed space entry, Hazard aw.answer: 因为我们需要知道可能存在什么有毒物质，以便可以进行测试。

CD0387 — Enclosed space entry, Hazard aw.question: ¿Por qué es necesario conocer la naturaleza de las cargas que se han almacenado anteriormente en un espacio de carga antes de entrar en él o en los espacios adyacentes? Seleccione la MEJOR respuesta.
options: Porque se debe saber qué sustancias tóxicas ha habido en ese espacio para poder comprobar su presencia.
Porque se debe saber qué sustancias inflamables ha habido en ese espacio para poder comprobar su presencia.
Porque se debe saber qué sustancias consumidoras de oxígeno ha habido en ese espacio para poder comprobar su presencia.
No es necesario conocerla, siempre que se utilice un equipo personal de detección de gas.
CD0387 — Enclosed space entry, Hazard aw.answer: Porque se debe saber qué sustancias tóxicas ha habido en ese espacio para poder comprobar su presencia.

CD0387 — Enclosed space entry, Hazard aw.question: Pourquoi devons-nous savoir quels chargements ont été transportés précédemment dans l'espace de chargement avant d'y entrer ou d'entrer dans l'un des espaces à proximité ? Sélectionnez une SEULE réponse, selon celle qui vous semble la meilleure.
options: Parce que nous devons savoir quelles substances toxiques peuvent être présentes afin d'effectuer les tests nécessaires.
Parce que nous devons savoir quelles substances inflammables peuvent être présentes afin d'effectuer les tests nécessaires.
Parce que nous devons savoir quelles substances consommant de l'oxygène peuvent être présentes afin d'effectuer les tests nécessaires.
Nous n'avons pas besoin de le savoir, si nous utilisons un dispositif de surveillance du gaz individuel.
CD0387 — Enclosed space entry, Hazard aw.answer: Parce que nous devons savoir quelles substances toxiques peuvent être présentes afin d'effectuer les tests nécessaires.

CD0387 — Enclosed space entry, Hazard aw.question: 진입하기 전 화물 공간에 또는 공간 옆에 어떤 화물을 보관했었는지 알아야 합니까? 가장 적합한 답을 하나 선택하십시오.
options: 시험할 수 있기 때문에 독성 물질이 있는지 알아야 하기 때문입니다.
시험할 수 있기 때문에 가연성 물질이 있는지 알아야 하기 때문입니다.
시험할 수 있기 때문에 산소 고갈 물질이 있는지 알아야 하기 때문입니다.
그렇지 않을 경우, 개인 가스 모니터를 사용합니다.
CD0387 — Enclosed space entry, Hazard aw.answer: 시험할 수 있기 때문에 독성 물질이 있는지 알아야 하기 때문입니다.

CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.question: The initial atmosphere checks for an enclosed space are to be carried out. Where should this be done from? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: Outside the space using portable equipment.
Inside the space using portable equipment.
The cargo control room, using fixed equipment.
Inside the space using personal gas detectors.
CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.answer: Outside the space using portable equipment.

CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.question: 要对密闭空间进行初始空气检查。应在何处进行检查？ 请选择一个正确答案。
options: 使用便携设备在空间外部进行检查。
使用便携设备在空间内部进行检查
使用固定设备在货物控制室内进行。
使用个人气体检测仪在空间内部进行检查。
CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.answer: 使用便携设备在空间外部进行检查。

CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.question: Es el momento de realizar las comprobaciones iniciales de la atmósfera en un espacio cerrado, ¿desde dónde deben hacerse estas comprobaciones? Seleccione la ÚNICA respuesta correcta.
options: Desde fuera del espacio cerrado, con un equipo portátil
Desde dentro del espacio cerrado, con un equipo portátil
Desde la sala de control de carga, con un equipo fijo
Desde dentro del espacio cerrado, con un equipo personal de detección de gas
CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.answer: Desde fuera del espacio cerrado, con un equipo portátil

CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.question: Des contrôles d’atmosphère préalables au sein d’un espace clos doivent impérativement être menés. Quelles zones doivent être testées ? Sélectionnez LA réponse correcte.
options: En dehors de l’espace, à l’aide d’un équipement portatif.
À l’intérieur de l’espace, à l’aide d’un équipement portatif.
Dans la salle de contrôle cargaison, au moyen d’un équipement fixe.
À l’intérieur de l’espace, au moyen de détecteurs de gaz individuels.
CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.answer: En dehors de l’espace, à l’aide d’un équipement portatif.

CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.question: 폐쇄된 공간에 대한 초기 대기 점검을 수행합니다. 이는 어디에서 수행해야 합니까? 올바른 답을 하나 선택하십시오.
options: 휴대용 장비를 사용하여 공간 외부에서.
휴대용 장비를 사용하여 공간 내부에서.
고정된 장비를 사용하여 화물 통제실에서.
개인 가스 검출기를 사용하여 공간 내부에서.
CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.answer: 휴대용 장비를 사용하여 공간 외부에서.

CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.question: According to this module, who should keep the duty officer informed about any persons entering or leaving an enclosed space? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: The attendant at the entrance to the space.
The person leading the team in the enclosed space.
The Permit holder.
The responsible person who issued the Permit.
CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.answer: The attendant at the entrance to the space.

CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.question: 根据本模块的内容，应该由谁随时告知值班官员任何人进入或离开密闭空间的情况？ 请选择一个正确答案。
options: 空间入口处的看护人员。
密闭空间内的团队领导人员。
许可证持有者。
颁发许可证的负责人。
CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.answer: 空间入口处的看护人员。

CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.question: Según lo explicado en este módulo, ¿quién es responsable de informar al oficial al mando de las personas que entran y salen del espacio cerrado? Seleccione la ÚNICA respuesta correcta.
options: El asistente que se encuentra en la entrada del espacio cerrado
La persona encargada de dirigir al equipo que se encuentra en el espacio cerrado
El titular del permiso
La persona responsable de la concesión del permiso
CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.answer: El asistente que se encuentra en la entrada del espacio cerrado

CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.question: Selon ce module, qui doit tenir informé l’agent de service en ce qui concerne l’accès des personnes dans un espace clos ? Sélectionnez LA réponse correcte.
options: Le gardien à l’entrée de l’espace.
La personne en charge de l’équipe dans l’espace clos.
Le détenteur du permis.
La personne responsable qui a délivré le permis.
CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.answer: Le gardien à l’entrée de l’espace.

CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.question: 이 모듈에 따르면 폐쇄된 공간에 진입하거나 떠나는 사람과 관련해 누가 당직사관에게 알려야 합니까? 올바른 답을 하나 선택하십시오.

CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.answer: 공간 입구에 있는 수행원.

CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.question: During an enclosed space entry, visual contact was the agreed method of communication. The team inside then move to a part of the space where the attendant cannot see them. What should be done? Select the ONE best answer.
