CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.answer: A second person should be put in a position where they can see both the team and the attendant to maintain constant communication.

CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.question: 在密闭空间进入期间，视线接触是商定的通信方式。内部团队之后移动到了看护人员无法看到他们的某个空间位置。应该怎么办？ 请选择一个最佳答案。
options: 应该在某个位置安排另外一个人，在此位置他们能够看到团队人员和看护人员，以保持持续通信。
应该商定由某个团队人员大约每五分钟来与看护人员接触一次。
看护人员应移至可以看到团队的位置。
看护人员应携带 BA 装置作为预防措施，并进入空间内部可以看到团队人员的某个位置。
CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.answer: 应该在某个位置安排另外一个人，在此位置他们能够看到团队人员和看护人员，以保持持续通信。

CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.question: Durante el acceso a un espacio cerrado, se acuerda que el método de comunicación será el contacto visual. El equipo se adentra en el espacio cerrado hasta situarse en un punto donde el asistente no puede ver a sus componentes. ¿Qué se debe hacer en esta situación? Seleccione LA mejor respuesta.
options: Una segunda persona deberá colocarse en un punto desde el que pueda ver tanto al equipo como al asistente para garantizar que haya una comunicación constante
Se deberá elegir a una persona del equipo para que se acerque al asistente cada cinco minutos, aproximadamente
El asistente deberá trasladarse a otra posición desde la que pueda ver al equipo
El asistente deberá coger un equipo de respiración, como medida de precaución, y trasladarse a otra posición dentro del espacio cerrado desde donde pueda ver al equipo
CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.answer: Una segunda persona deberá colocarse en un punto desde el que pueda ver tanto al equipo como al asistente para garantizar que haya una comunicación constante

CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.question: Lors d'une opération dans un espace clos, il était convenu de maintenir la communication par contact visuel. L’équipe à l’intérieur de l’espace se déplace et le gardien n’est plus en mesure de la surveiller. Que faire ? Sélectionnez une SEULE réponse, selon celle qui vous semble la meilleure.
options: Une deuxième personne doit être placée à un endroit stratégique, de sorte à garder un contact visuel tant avec l’équipe qu’avec le gardien.
Un membre désigné de l’équipe doit prendre contact avec le gardien toutes les cinq minutes environ.
Le gardien doit se placer à un endroit d’où il peut surveiller l’équipe.
Le gardien doit prévoir, par mesure de précaution, un appareil respiratoire et se placer à l’intérieur de l’espace à un endroit d’où il peut surveiller l’équipe.
CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.answer: Une deuxième personne doit être placée à un endroit stratégique, de sorte à garder un contact visuel tant avec l’équipe qu’avec le gardien.

CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.question: 폐쇄된 공간으로 진입 시 시각적 접촉은 합의된 커뮤니케이션 방법입니다. 그런 다음 내부에 있는 팀은 수행원이 그들을 볼 수 없는 공간 일부로 이동합니다. 무엇을 해야 합니까? 가장 적합한 답을 하나 선택하십시오.
options: 두 번째 사람은 일정한 커뮤니케이션을 유지하기 위해 이들이 팀과 수행원 모두를 볼 수 있는 위치에 있어야 합니다.
팀원이 와서 5분마다 수행원과 접촉하도록 합의해야 합니다.
수행원은 팀을 볼 수 있는 위치로 이동해야 합니다.
수행원은 예방조치로 BA 세트를 갖춰야 하며 팀을 볼 수 있는 위치인 공간 내부로 이동해야 합니다.
CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.answer: 두 번째 사람은 일정한 커뮤니케이션을 유지하기 위해 이들이 팀과 수행원 모두를 볼 수 있는 위치에 있어야 합니다.

CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.question: When should an enclosed space be tested with approved portable gas detectors? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: Before entry and periodically.
Before entry only.
Before entry, if any doubt exists about the atmosphere in the space.
Before entry, and periodically if personal gas detectors are not worn.
CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.answer: Before entry and periodically.

CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.question: 何时应该使用经过认证的便携式气体检测仪测试密闭空间？ 请选择一个正确答案。
options: 进入之前以及进入之后定期测试。
仅进入之前。
进入之前，如果对空间内的空气存在任何疑问的话。
进入之前，如果未携带个人气体检测仪时定期进行测试。
CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.answer: 进入之前以及进入之后定期测试。

CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.question: ¿Cuándo se debe comprobar la idoneidad de un espacio cerrado con un equipo portátil de detección de gas homologado? Seleccione la ÚNICA respuesta correcta.
options: Antes de entrar y cada cierto tiempo
Solo antes de entrar
Antes de entrar, siempre que se tenga alguna duda sobre la idoneidad de la atmósfera de dicho espacio
Antes de entrar, y cada cierto tiempo si no se dispone de un equipo personal de detección de gas
CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.answer: Antes de entrar y cada cierto tiempo

CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.question: Quand un espace clos doit-il être testé avec des détecteurs de gaz portatifs homologués ? Sélectionnez LA réponse correcte.
options: Avant d'entrer dans l’espace clos et à intervalles réguliers.
Uniquement avant d'entrer dans l’espace clos.
Avant d'entrer, en cas de doute concernant l’atmosphère au sein de l’espace.
Avant d'entrer et à intervalles réguliers en l’absence de détecteurs de gaz individuels.
CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.answer: Avant d'entrer dans l’espace clos et à intervalles réguliers.

CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.question: 승인된 휴대용 가스 검출기를 사용해 폐쇄된 공간을 언제 검사해야 합니까? 올바른 답을 하나 선택하십시오.
options: 진입하기 전 및 주기적으로.
진입하기 전에만.
진입하기 전, 공간 내 대기와 관련해 의문이 들 경우.
진입하기 전 및 개인 가스 검출기를 착용하지 않은 경우 주기적으로.
CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.answer: 진입하기 전 및 주기적으로.

CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.question: How should entry to an enclosed space be controlled? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: The attendant should keep a record (tally) on who goes in and comes out.
People should report to the bridge before entering and after leaving.
People should report to the Master or Chief Officer before entering and after leaving.
Anyone named on the Permit can enter or leave at any time until the Permit is withdrawn.
CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.answer: The attendant should keep a record (tally) on who goes in and comes out.

CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.question: 应该如何控制密闭空间的入口？ 请选择一个正确答案。
options: 看护人员应该记录（清点）进出的人数。
人们应该在进入之前和离开之后报告给驾驶台。
人们应该在进入之前和离开之后报告给船长或大副。
许可证上指定的任何人都可以随时进入或离开，直到许可证撤销。
CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.answer: 看护人员应该记录（清点）进出的人数。

CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.question: ¿Cómo se debe controlar el acceso a un espacio cerrado? Seleccione la ÚNICA respuesta correcta.
options: El asistente debe llevar un registro de todas las personas que entran y salen
Todo el mundo debe informar al puente de mando antes de entrar y después de salir
Todo el mundo debe informar al capitán o al oficial al mando antes de entrar y después de salir
Todas las personas cuyo nombre aparezca en el permiso pueden entrar y salir siempre que lo deseen durante el periodo de validez del permiso
CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.answer: El asistente debe llevar un registro de todas las personas que entran y salen

CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.question: Comment l’accès à un espace clos doit-il être contrôlé ? Sélectionnez LA réponse correcte.
options: Le gardien doit conserver un registre (de compte) des allées et venues des travailleurs.
Les travailleurs doivent prévenir la passerelle avant d'entrer dans l’espace et en le quittant.
Les travailleurs doivent prévenir le capitaine ou le second capitaine avant d'entrer dans l’espace et en le quittant.
Toute personne autorisée par le permis peut entrer ou quitter l’espace à tout moment jusqu’à expiration de la date de validité.
CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.answer: Le gardien doit conserver un registre (de compte) des allées et venues des travailleurs.

CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.question: 폐쇄된 공간으로 진입 시 어떻게 통제해야 합니까? 올바른 답을 하나 선택하십시오.
options: 수행원은 들어오고 나가는 사람을 기록해야 합니다.
사람들은 진입하기 전 및 떠난 후에 브리지에 보고해야 합니다.
사람들은 진입하기 전 및 떠난 후에 선장 또는 일등항해사에 보고해야 합니다.
허가증에 기재된 사람은 허가가 철회될 때까지 언제든 들어가거나 나갈 수 있습니다.
CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.answer: 수행원은 들어오고 나가는 사람을 기록해야 합니다.

CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.question: During an entry to an enclosed space, where should rescue equipment be located? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: At the entrance to the space.
In the emergency headquarters.
Inside the space, at the lowest level.
At a convenient muster station.
CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.answer: At the entrance to the space.

CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.question: 在进入密闭空间期间，应该在何处放置营救设备？ 请选择一个正确答案。
options: 在空间入口处。
应急中心总部。
空间内，最低水平面处。
在方便的集合位置。
CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.answer: 在空间入口处。

CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.question: ¿Dónde se debe dejar el equipo de rescate durante el acceso a un espacio cerrado? Seleccione la ÚNICA respuesta correcta.
options: En la entrada al espacio
En la sala de urgencias
Dentro del espacio cerrado, en el nivel inferior
En un punto de reunión cercano
CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.answer: En la entrada al espacio

CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.question: En cas d’accès à un espace clos, où l’équipement de secours doit-il être installé ? Sélectionnez LA réponse correcte.
options: À l’entrée de l’espace.
Dans les centres d’urgence.
À l’intérieur de l’espace, au niveau le plus bas.
Dans un lieu de rassemblement pratique.
CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.answer: À l’entrée de l’espace.

CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.question: 폐쇄된 공간에 진입하는 동안 구조 장비는 어디에 배치해야 합니까? 올바른 답을 하나 선택하십시오.
options: 공간 입구에.
비상 본부에.
해당 공간의 가장 낮은 곳에.
편리한 집합 장소에.
CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.answer: 공간 입구에.

CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.question: What are the SOLAS requirements for portable instruments to detect toxic gases? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: The ship must carry appropriate portable instruments for the substances it carries.
If the space contains 21% oxygen and zero flammable gas then this is evidence of sufficient ventilation.
If zero readings for hydrogen sulphide and carbon monoxide are obtained then that is a good indication that there are no toxic gases.
No entry to spaces that have carried toxic substances is allowed without wearing a chemical suit and breathing apparatus.
CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.answer: The ship must carry appropriate portable instruments for the substances it carries.

CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.question: SOLAS 对于便携仪器检测有毒气体的要求是什么？ 请选择一个正确答案。
options: 船只必须针对所携带的物质携带恰当的便携仪器。
如果空间内含有 21% 的氧气，不含可燃气体，则表明通风充分。
如果获取的硫化氢和一氧化碳读数为零，则表示没有有毒气体。
不穿戴化学品工作服和呼吸装置的情况下，不允许进入携带过有毒物质的空间。
CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.answer: 船只必须针对所携带的物质携带恰当的便携仪器。

CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.question: ¿Qué requisitos establece el convenio SOLAS para los equipos portátiles de detección de gases tóxicos? Seleccione la ÚNICA respuesta correcta.
options: El navío debe disponer de los equipos portátiles que correspondan para las sustancias que transporta
Si el espacio ya cuenta con un 21 % de oxígeno y un 0 % de gases inflamables, se puede determinar que hay suficiente ventilación
Si las mediciones de ácido sulfhídrico y monóxido de carbono son de un 0 %, es un buen indicativo de que no habrá gases tóxicos
Está prohibido entrar a un espacio en el que se hayan almacenado sustancias tóxicas sin el traje químico y el equipo de respiración correspondientes
CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.answer: El navío debe disponer de los equipos portátiles que correspondan para las sustancias que transporta

CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.question: Que prévoit la convention SOLAS en matière d’instruments portatifs destinés à détecter des gaz toxiques ? Sélectionnez LA réponse correcte.
options: Le navire doit être équipé d’instruments portatifs adaptés pour les substances transportées.
Si l’espace renferme 21 % d’oxygène et 0 % de gaz inflammable, la ventilation est alors jugée efficace.
Si l’absence totale de sulfure d’hydrogène et de monoxyde de carbone est confirmée, cela indique l’absence de gaz toxiques.
Aucun accès aux espaces de stockage de substances toxiques n’est autorisé sans combinaison chimique et appareil respiratoire.
CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.answer: Le navire doit être équipé d’instruments portatifs adaptés pour les substances transportées.

CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.question: 유독 가스를 검출하는 휴대용 기기에 대한 SOLAS 요건은 어떠합니까? 올바른 답을 하나 선택하십시오.
options: 선박은 해당 물질에 대한 적절한 휴대용 기기를 갖춰야 합니다.
공간에 21% 산소와 가연성 가스가 없다면 이는 충분히 환기된다는 증거입니다.
황화수소 및 일산화탄소 판독값이 0인 경우 유독 가스가 없다는 것을 보여줍니다.
화학 장비 및 호흡 장치를 착용하지 않은 상태에서 유독 물질이 있는 공간에 진입하는 것이 허용되지 않습니다.
CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.answer: 선박은 해당 물질에 대한 적절한 휴대용 기기를 갖춰야 합니다.

CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.question: If you are inside an enclosed space and the attendant tells you to leave, what should you do? Select the ONE best answer.
options: Leave immediately and make sure everyone else in the team does the same.
Contact the responsible person and ask why you have to leave the space.
Ask the attendant why you have to leave the space.
Ensure that any tasks are complete, gather up all tools and then leave.
CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.answer: Leave immediately and make sure everyone else in the team does the same.

CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.question: 如果您在密闭空间内，看护人员告诉您离开，您该怎么做？ 请选择一个最佳答案。
options: 立即离开，确保团队的任何其他人员也立即离开。
联系负责人，询问为什么必须离开空间。
询问看护人员为什么必须离开空间。
确保完成任何任务，收起所有工具，然后离开。
CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.answer: 立即离开，确保团队的任何其他人员也立即离开。

CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.question: Si se encuentra dentro de un espacio cerrado y el asistente le pide que salga, ¿qué deberá hacer? Seleccione LA mejor respuesta.
options: Salir inmediatamente y cerciorarme de que el resto del equipo haga lo mismo
Ponerse en contacto con la persona responsable para preguntarle por qué debería salir del espacio cerrado
Preguntarle al asistente por qué debería salir del espacio cerrado
Asegurarse de que se han realizado todas las tareas, recoger las herramientas y salir
CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.answer: Salir inmediatamente y cerciorarme de que el resto del equipo haga lo mismo

CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.question: Vous êtes à l’intérieur d’un espace clos et le gardien vous somme de quitter les lieux. Que devez-vous faire ? Sélectionnez une SEULE réponse, selon celle qui vous semble la meilleure.
options: Quitter les lieux immédiatement et s’assurer que les autres membres de l’équipe font de même.
Contacter le responsable et lui demander une explication.
Demander au gardien une explication.
Vérifier que toutes les tâches ont été menées, rassembler tous les outils et quitter les lieux.
CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.answer: Quitter les lieux immédiatement et s’assurer que les autres membres de l’équipe font de même.

CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.question: 폐쇄된 공간 내부에 있으며 수행원이 떠나라고 할 경우 어떻게 해야합니까? 가장 적합한 답을 하나 선택하십시오.
options: 즉시 떠나며 팀 내 모든 사람이 같이 떠나도록 합니다.
책임자에게 연락하여 공간을 떠나야 하는 이유를 묻습니다.
공간을 떠나야 하는 이유에 대해 수행원에게 묻습니다.
모든 작업이 완료되었는지 확인하고 모든 도구를 모은 후 떠납니다.
CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.answer: 즉시 떠나며 팀 내 모든 사람이 같이 떠나도록 합니다.

CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.question: Who is the best person to ensure your safety in an enclosed space? Select the ONE best answer.
options: Yourself, by constantly carrying out a personal risk assessment.
The person who wrote the permit.
The person who authorized the permit.
The person in charge of the work.
CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.answer: Yourself, by constantly carrying out a personal risk assessment.

CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.question: 谁是确保您在密闭空间内安全的最佳人选？ 请选择一个最佳答案。
options: 您自己，总是执行个人风险评估。
填写许可证的人员。
授权许可证的人员。
负责作业的人员。
CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.answer: 您自己，总是执行个人风险评估。

CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.question: ¿Quién puede garantizar su seguridad mejor que nadie en un espacio cerrado? Seleccione LA mejor respuesta.
options: Usted mejor que nadie, mediante la constante evaluación de riesgos personales
La persona que redactó el permiso
La persona que autorizó el permiso
La persona a cargo del trabajo
CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.answer: Usted mejor que nadie, mediante la constante evaluación de riesgos personales

CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.question: Quelle est la personne la plus habilitée à garantir votre sécurité dans un espace clos ? Sélectionnez une SEULE réponse, selon celle qui vous semble la meilleure.
options: Vous-même, à travers une évaluation personnelle des risques continue.
La personne à l’origine de la rédaction du permis.
La personne à l’origine de l’approbation du permis.
La personne chargée des opérations.
CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.answer: Vous-même, à travers une évaluation personnelle des risques continue.

CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.question: 폐쇄된 공간에서 안전을 보장할 수 있는 최적임자는 누구입니까? 가장 적합한 답을 하나 선택하십시오.
options: 개인 위험 평가를 일정하게 수행한 본인 자신.
허가증을 작성한 사람.
허가 권한을 부여받은 사람.
작업 담당자.
CD0388 — Enclosed space entry, The entry.answer: 개인 위험 평가를 일정하게 수행한 본인 자신.

CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.question: Why must an unconscious person be rescued from an enclosed space as quickly as possible?
options: Because there is a risk of lack of oxygen, which can cause death in a very short time.
Because they could have fallen and injured themselves.
So that their condition can be assessed by someone outside the space.
Because they might be suffering from heat exhaustion.
CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.answer: Because there is a risk of lack of oxygen, which can cause death in a very short time.

CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.question: 为什么必须尽快将失去意识的人从密闭空间内营救出来？
options: 因为存在缺氧风险，在很短时间内就可能导致死亡。
因为可能掉下来，弄伤他们自己。
这样空间外面的人可以评估他们的状况。
因为他们可能中暑了。
CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.answer: 因为存在缺氧风险，在很短时间内就可能导致死亡。

CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.question: El rescate de una persona que ha quedado inconsciente en un espacio cerrado debe realizarse lo antes posible. ¿Por qué?
options: Porque puede que no haya oxígeno suficiente, lo que podría provocar su muerte en poco tiempo
Porque puede haberse lesionado como consecuencia de una caída
Para que alguien pueda evaluar su estado fuera del espacio cerrado
Porque puede estar sufriendo un golpe de calor
CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.answer: Porque puede que no haya oxígeno suficiente, lo que podría provocar su muerte en poco tiempo

CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.question: Pourquoi doit-on sauver une personne inconsciente présente dans un espace clos dans les plus brefs délais ?
options: Car la victime pourrait manquer d’oxygène et en mourir très rapidement.
Car la victime peut s’être blessée lors d’une chute.
Afin que l’état de santé de la victime puisse être évalué par une personne à l’extérieur de l’espace.
Car la victime pourrait souffrir d’un coup de chaleur.
CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.answer: Car la victime pourrait manquer d’oxygène et en mourir très rapidement.

CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.question: 의식이 없는 사람은 왜 최대한 빨리 폐쇄된 공간에서 구조되어야 합니까?
options: 산소가 부족하여 매우 짧은 시간에 사망할 수 있기 때문입니다.
쓰러져 부상을 입을 수 있기 때문입니다.
공간 외부에 있는 사람으로부터 상태를 평가받기 위함입니다.
열사병으로부터 고통받을 수 있기 때문입니다.
CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.answer: 산소가 부족하여 매우 짧은 시간에 사망할 수 있기 때문입니다.

CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.question: According to SOLAS, how often must enclosed space drills be carried out?
options: At least every two months.
At least every six months.
At least every week.
Each person in the team must have taken part in a drill within the last 12 months.
CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.answer: At least every two months.

CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.question: 根据 SOLAS 的规定，应该多长时间进行一次密闭空间演习？
options: 至少每两个月一次。
至少每六个月一次。
至少每周一次。
每个团队成员均须在过去 12 个月内参加过演习。
CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.answer: 至少每两个月一次。

CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.question: Según el convenio SOLAS, ¿con qué frecuencia se deben realizar simulacros en espacios cerrados?
options: Al menos una vez cada dos meses
Al menos una vez cada seis meses
Al menos una vez cada semana
Todas las personas que componen el equipo deben haber participado en un simulacro durante los últimos doce meses
CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.answer: Al menos una vez cada dos meses

CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.question: Conformément à la convention SOLAS, à quelle fréquence les exercices pratiques dédiés aux espaces clos doivent-ils être effectués ?
options: Au moins tous les deux mois.
Au moins tous les six mois.
Au moins chaque semaine.
Chaque membre de l’équipe doit participer à un exercice pratique au moins chaque année.
CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.answer: Au moins tous les deux mois.

CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.question: SOLAS에 따르면 폐쇄된 공간 훈련은 얼마나 자주 수행해야 합니까?
options: 2개월에 1회 이상.
6개월에 1회 이상.
매주 1회 이상.
각 팀원은 지난 12개월 내에 훈련에 참여했어야 합니다.
CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.answer: 2개월에 1회 이상.

CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.question: If an airline supply is being used in an enclosed space, what arrangements must be made in case it fails?
options: There must be a way to immediately restore an alternative supply.
Additional BA sets must be available at the entrance to the space.
An Emergency Escape Breathing Device must be available nearby.
Persons should have clear instructions to leave the space immediately.
CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.answer: There must be a way to immediately restore an alternative supply.

CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.question: 如果在密闭空间内使用空气管道供应，如果发生故障应该进行什么安排？
options: 必须存在立即恢复备用供应的方式。
在空间入口处必须提供附加的呼吸装置。
在附近必须提供紧急逃生呼吸设备。
人们应该收到明确的指导，立即离开空间。
CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.answer: 必须存在立即恢复备用供应的方式。

CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.question: Si se utiliza en un espacio cerrado un equipo de suministro de aire con conexión al exterior, ¿qué preparativos deben tenerse en cuenta por si falla algo?
options: Debe preverse una forma alternativa de restaurar inmediatamente el suministro de aire
Se debe disponer de equipos de respiración adicionales en la entrada del espacio cerrado
Debe haber un equipo de respiración para evacuaciones de emergencia cerca
Todo el mundo debe tener claro que hay que salir inmediatamente del espacio cerrado si falla algo
CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.answer: Debe preverse una forma alternativa de restaurar inmediatamente el suministro de aire

CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.question: Si un système de ventilation est prévu dans un espace clos, quelles sont les précautions à prendre en cas de défaillance ?
options: Une alimentation alternative doit pouvoir être utilisée immédiatement.
Des appareils respiratoires supplémentaires doivent être prévus à l’entrée de l’espace.
Un appareil respiratoire de secours doit être disponible à proximité.
L’ordre de quitter l’espace immédiatement doit être compris par chaque travailleur.
CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.answer: Une alimentation alternative doit pouvoir être utilisée immédiatement.

CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.question: 공기배관 공급을 폐쇄된 공간에 사용한다면 이러한 공급이 중단될 경우 어떤 준비를 해야 합니까?
options: 대체 공급 수단을 즉시 복구하기 위한 방법이 있어야 합니다.
공간 입구에서 추가 BA 세트를 사용할 수 있어야 합니다.
인근에서 긴급 탈출 호흡 장치를 사용할 수 있어야 합니다.
사람들에게 해당 공간에서 즉시 떠나기 위한 명확한 지침이 있어야 합니다.
CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.answer: 대체 공급 수단을 즉시 복구하기 위한 방법이 있어야 합니다.

CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.question: Some substances like Benzene are not immediately toxic in small amounts, but must still be avoided. Why is this?
options: They have long term health effects.
They are highly flammable.
They can burn the skin on contact.
They cause pneumonia like symptoms.
CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.answer: They have long term health effects.

CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.question: 某些物质少量接触时没有立即毒性，如苯，但仍然必须加以避免。这是为什么？
options: 它们具有长期健康影响。
它们是极度易燃。
接触时它们可能灼伤皮肤。
它们会导致肺炎等症状。
CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.answer: 它们具有长期健康影响。

CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.question: Haya determinadas sustancias, como el benceno, que no son tóxicas de forma inmediata para nuestro organismo si se inhalan en pequeñas cantidades, pero que aún así deben evitarse. ¿Cuál es el motivo?
options: A largo plazo, afectan negativamente a la salud
Son muy inflamables
Pueden provocar quemaduras al entrar en contacto con la piel
Provocan síntomas similares a los de la neumonía
CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.answer: A largo plazo, afectan negativamente a la salud

CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.question: Certaines substances, comme le benzène, ne sont pas immédiatement toxiques en petites quantités, mais doivent toutefois être évitées. Pourquoi ?
options: Elles ont des effets néfastes sur la santé à long terme.
Elles sont hautement inflammables.
Elles provoquent des brûlures en cas de contact avec la peau.
Elles provoquent des symptômes de pneumonie.
CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.answer: Elles ont des effets néfastes sur la santé à long terme.

CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.question: 벤젠 같은 일부 물질은 소량으로는 즉각적인 유해성은 띠지 않지만 피해야 합니다. 왜 그렇습니까?
options: 건강에 장기적인 영향을 줍니다.
가연성이 높습니다.
접촉 시 피부 화상을 입을 수 있습니다.
폐렴 같은 증상을 초래할 수 있습니다.
CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.answer: 건강에 장기적인 영향을 줍니다.

CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.question: You are in an enclosed space and notice that a colleague has a cherry red tinge to their skin. What would you suspect?
options: That there is carbon monoxide present in the space.
That there is hydrogen sulphide in the space.
That there is hydrocarbon vapour in the space.
That there is carbon dioxide in the space.
CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.answer: That there is carbon monoxide present in the space.

CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.question: 您处于密闭空间内，发现某个同事皮肤出现樱桃红色。您会怀疑发生什么情况？
options: 空间内存在一氧化碳。
空间内存在硫化氢。
空间内存在碳氢化合物蒸汽。
空间内存在二氧化碳。
CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.answer: 空间内存在一氧化碳。

CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.question: Se encuentra en un espacio cerrado y detecta el enrojecimiento de la piel de un compañero. ¿A qué cree que puede deberse?
options: A la presencia de monóxido de carbono en el espacio cerrado
A la presencia de ácido sulfhídrico en el espacio cerrado
A la presencia de vapor de gases hidrocarbonados en el espacio cerrado
A la presencia de dióxido de carbono en el espacio cerrado
CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.answer: A la presencia de monóxido de carbono en el espacio cerrado

CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.question: Au sein d’un espace clos, vous remarquez une coloration cutanée « rouge cerise » sur un collègue. Que devriez-vous craindre ?
options: La présence de monoxyde de carbone dans l’espace.
La présence de sulfure d’hydrogène dans l’espace.
La présence de vapeur d’hydrocarbure dans l’espace.
La présence de dioxyde de carbone dans l’espace.
CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.answer: La présence de monoxyde de carbone dans l’espace.

CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.question: 귀하가 폐쇄된 공간에 있고 동료 피부가 선홍색으로 변한 것을 발견했습니다. 어떤 상황을 의심해볼 수 있습니까?
options: 공간에 일산화탄소가 있습니다.
공간에 황화수소가 있습니다.
공간에 탄화수소 증기가 있습니다.
공간에 이산화탄소가 있습니다.
CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.answer: 공간에 일산화탄소가 있습니다.

CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.question: What is the ‘golden rule’ for a rescue from an enclosed space?
options: Follow procedures and use a plan.
Get into the space and get people out as quickly as possible, no matter what the risks.
Ignore the risks to yourself when helping others.
If you can see a casualty, you can rescue them with no risk to yourself.
CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.answer: Follow procedures and use a plan.

CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.question: 从密闭空间进行营救的“黄金规则”是什么？
options: 遵循程序和使用计划。
进入空间，尽快救出人，无论风险如何。
帮助他人时忽略自己的风险。
如果可以看到伤者，则可以救出他们，自己不会存在风险。
CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.answer: 遵循程序和使用计划。

CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.question: ¿Cuál es la «regla de oro» que se debe tener siempre en cuenta a la hora de realizar un rescate en un espacio cerrado?
options: Seguir los procedimientos y aplicar el plan acordado
Entrar en el espacio cerrado y sacar a la gente lo más rápido posible, independientemente de los riesgos
Ignorar los riesgos personales que corremos cuando ayudamos a otras personas
Si se puede ver a la persona accidentada es que se la puede rescatar sin correr ningún riesgo
CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.answer: Seguir los procedimientos y aplicar el plan acordado

CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.question: Quelle est la règle d’or dans le cadre d’une mission de sauvetage en espace clos ?
options: Suivre les procédures et respecter un plan.
Accéder à l’espace et évacuer au plus vite les personnes présentes, indépendamment des risques.
Ignorer les risques pour sa propre sécurité en vue d’aider les autres.
Si la victime se trouve dans votre champ de vision, son sauvetage ne présente aucun risque.
CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.answer: Suivre les procédures et respecter un plan.

CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.question: 폐쇄된 공간에서 구조할 시 '황금률'은 무엇입니까?
options: 절차를 준수하여 계획을 사용하는 것.
위험이 있음에도 불구하고 해당 공간에 진입하여 최대한 빨리 사람을 구조하는 것.
타인을 도울 때 본인의 위험은 개의치 않는 것.
사상자가 있는 것을 확인한 경우 본인에게 아무런 위험 없이 사상자를 구조할 수 있습니다.
CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.answer: 절차를 준수하여 계획을 사용하는 것.

CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.question: When would an airline type Breathing Apparatus be necessary for a rescue from an enclosed space?
options: When the rescue team would need to pass through small openings.
When the rescue team has to pass through one space to reach another.
When the casualty cannot be seen from the entrance to the space.
When the rescue team has to use a vertical ladder.
CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.answer: When the rescue team would need to pass through small openings.

CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.question: 从密闭空间进行营救时，何时需要佩戴空气供应型呼吸装置？
options: 营救团队需要穿过很小的开口时。
营救团队需要从一个空间穿过进入另一个空间时。
从空间入口无法看到伤者时。
营救团队必须使用竖向梯子时。
CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.answer: 营救团队需要穿过很小的开口时。

CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.question: ¿En qué casos es necesario utilizar un equipo de respiración con conexión al exterior para llevar a cabo un rescate en un espacio cerrado?
options: Cuando el equipo de rescate debe acceder al espacio cerrado por una pequeña apertura
Cuando el equipo de rescate debe atravesar un espacio cerrado para acceder a otro
Cuando no se puede ver a la persona accidentada desde la entrada al espacio cerrado
Cuando el equipo de rescate necesita una escalera vertical para acceder al espacio cerrado
CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.answer: Cuando el equipo de rescate debe acceder al espacio cerrado por una pequeña apertura

CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.question: Dans quelle situation un appareil respiratoire à ventilation assistée se révèle-t-il nécessaire en cas de sauvetage au sein d’un espace clos ?
options: Lorsque l’équipe de sauvetage doit passer par de petites ouvertures.
Lorsque l’équipe de sauvetage doit passer par un espace pour accéder à un autre.
Lorsque la victime n’est pas visible depuis l’entrée de l’espace.
Lorsque l’équipe de sauvetage doit utiliser une échelle verticale.
CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.answer: Lorsque l’équipe de sauvetage doit passer par de petites ouvertures.

CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.question: 폐쇄된 공간에서 구조할 시 공기배관 유형 호흡 장치가 언제 필요합니까?
options: 구조팀이 작은 입구를 통과해야 할 경우.
구조팀이 한 공간을 통과해 다른 곳에 도달해야 할 경우.
입구에서 해당 공간에 이르기까지 사상자를 확인할 수 없는 경우.
구조팀이 수직 사다리를 사용해야 할 경우.
CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.answer: 구조팀이 작은 입구를 통과해야 할 경우.

CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.question: During an enclosed space entry, it is found that more work is needed than was stated on the Permit to Work. What should happen?
options: All persons should leave the space, a new risk assessment should be carried out and a new Permit issued.
There should be consultation between the responsible person and the person doing the work to agree to the new work.
The person in charge of the work should decide if the additional work would cause any problems.
The Chief Officer can decide if this extra work would cause any danger.
CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.answer: All persons should leave the space, a new risk assessment should be carried out and a new Permit issued.

CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.question: 在密闭空间进入期间，发现所需作业范围超过作业许可证上标明的任务范围。应该怎么办？
options: 所有人员应立即离开空间，重新进行风险评估，颁发新的许可证。
负责人和作业人员应商定新的作业。
作业负责人员应决定附加的作业是否会导致任何问题。
大副可以决定这种附加作业是否会导致危险。
CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.answer: 所有人员应立即离开空间，重新进行风险评估，颁发新的许可证。

CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.question: Durante el acceso a un espacio cerrado se determina que las tareas especificadas en el permiso de trabajo no son suficientes para completar dicho trabajo. ¿Qué se debe hacer en estos casos?
options: Todo el mundo deberá evacuar el espacio cerrado para que se pueda realizar una nueva evaluación de riesgos y se conceda un nuevo permiso de trabajo
La persona responsable del trabajo y la persona encargada de su realización deberán hablar para acordar el procedimiento necesario
La persona encargada del trabajo deberá decidir si las tareas adicionales pueden suponer un problema
El primer oficial deberá determinar si las tareas adicionales pueden suponer algún peligro
CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.answer: Todo el mundo deberá evacuar el espacio cerrado para que se pueda realizar una nueva evaluación de riesgos y se conceda un nuevo permiso de trabajo

CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.question: En cas d’accès à un espace clos, les travailleurs remarquent que l’opération sera plus complexe que celle prévue dans le permis de travail. Que devrait-il se passer ?
options: Les personnes doivent quitter l’espace, une nouvelle évaluation des risques doit être effectuée et un nouveau permis doit être délivré.
Le responsable et le travailleur doivent se concerter au sujet des nouvelles tâches.
Le responsable des opérations doit décider si les tâches supplémentaires peuvent constituer ou non un problème.
Le second capitaine peut décider si les tâches supplémentaires représentent un danger.
CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.answer: Les personnes doivent quitter l’espace, une nouvelle évaluation des risques doit être effectuée et un nouveau permis doit être délivré.

CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.question: 폐쇄된 공간 진입 시 작업 허가증에 명시된 것보다 더 많은 작업이 필요하다는 것이 확인되었습니다. 어떤 일이 일어나야 합니까?
options: 모든 사람은 해당 공간을 떠나야 하며 새로운 위험 평가를 수행하고 새로운 허가증을 발행해야 합니다.
새로운 작업에 합의하기 위해 책임자와 작업 담당자 간에 논의해야 합니다.
작업 담당자는 추가 작업으로 문제가 발생할 수 있는지 결정해야 합니다.
일등항해사는 추가 작업으로 위험이 초래될 수 있는지 결정할 수 있습니다.
CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.answer: 모든 사람은 해당 공간을 떠나야 하며 새로운 위험 평가를 수행하고 새로운 허가증을 발행해야 합니다.

CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.question: Carbon monoxide is a toxic gas, which may be present in enclosed spaces onboard ship. Where is it most likely to come from?
options: From Inert gas or diesel engine exhaust.
From decomposition of ballast water.
From the previous cargo.
It is present in normal air.
CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.answer: From Inert gas or diesel engine exhaust.

CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.question: 一氧化碳是一种有毒气体，船上密闭空间可能存在这种气体。这种气体最可能来自何处？
options: 来自惰性气体或柴油轮机排气。
来自压载水的分解。
来自之前的货物。
存在于正常空气中。
CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.answer: 来自惰性气体或柴油轮机排气。

CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.question: El monóxido de carbono es un gas tóxico que puede estar presente en los espacios cerrados del barco. ¿De dónde es más probable que proceda?
options: De un gas inerte o del escape de un motor diésel
De la descomposición del agua de un depósito de lastre
De la carga anterior
Es un gas que se encuentra habitualmente en el aire
CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.answer: De un gas inerte o del escape de un motor diésel

CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.question: Le monoxyde de carbone est un gaz toxique, potentiellement présent dans les espaces clos à bord des navires. D’où provient-il essentiellement ?
options: D’un gaz inerte ou des échappements de moteur diesel.
De la décomposition de l’eau du ballast.
De la précédente cargaison.
De l’air.
CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.answer: D’un gaz inerte ou des échappements de moteur diesel.

CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.question: 일산화탄소는 유독 가스이며 선상의 폐쇄된 공간에 존재할 수 있습니다. 이런 물질은 대개 어디서 발생합니까?
options: 불활성 가스 또는 디젤 엔진 배기가스에서.
물 밸러스트 분해로 인해.
이전 화물에서.
보통 공기에 존재.
CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.answer: 불활성 가스 또는 디젤 엔진 배기가스에서.

CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.question: What is the purpose of a debrief after an enclosed space rescue drill?
options: To discuss any problems and suggest improvements.
To tell everyone where to put the equipment after they’ve finished with it.
To blame people for anything they did wrong.
There is no need for a debrief if everything went okay.
CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.answer: To discuss any problems and suggest improvements.

CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.question: 密闭空间营救演习之后说明会的目的是什么？
options: 讨论任何问题，提出改进建议。
告诉每个人设备用完后应该放在何处。
谴责做错任何事情的人。
如果一切正常则无需说明会。
CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.answer: 讨论任何问题，提出改进建议。

CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.question: ¿Para qué sirven las reuniones que se realizan tras un simulacro de rescate en un espacio cerrado?
options: Para comentar los posibles problemas y sugerir formas de mejorar la actuación
Para indicarle a todo el mundo dónde se debe dejar el equipo una vez finalizado el simulacro
Para reprochar al equipo los errores cometidos
No es necesario reunirse tras el simulacro si todo ha ido bien
CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.answer: Para comentar los posibles problemas y sugerir formas de mejorar la actuación

CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.question: À quoi sert une réunion de compte-rendu après un exercice pratique de sauvetage en espace clos ?
options: Pour soulever les éventuels problèmes et proposer des améliorations.
Pour rappeler à chaque travailleur l’endroit où l’équipement doit être rangé une fois l’opération terminée.
Pour faire des remarques aux travailleurs en cas d’erreur.
Il est inutile d’organiser une telle réunion si tout s’est bien déroulé.
CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.answer: Pour soulever les éventuels problèmes et proposer des améliorations.

CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.question: 폐쇄된 공간 구조 훈련 후 결과보고의 목적은 무엇입니까?
options: 문제에 대해 논의하고 개선사항을 제안하기 위해.
훈련 완료 후 장비를 어디 둘지 모든 사람에게 알리기 위해.
잘못을 저지른 사람을 질책하기 위해.
모든 일이 잘된 경우 결과보고할 필요가 없습니다.
CD0389 — Enclosed space entry, Emergenci.answer: 문제에 대해 논의하고 개선사항을 제안하기 위해.

CD0390 — Harassment and bullying.question: All of the following are among the nine characteristics protected by the laws of European Union and many countries EXCEPT which one?
options: Religion and beliefs
Race
Sexual orientation
Fashion preferences
CD0390 — Harassment and bullying.answer: Fashion preferences

CD0390 — Harassment and bullying.question: In explaining the process, the senior officer should tell that he/she will ask the complainant a number of questions and write notes in order to __________.
options: Be able to present the answers to the alleged bully.
Record the answers for the complainant’s next performance appraisal.
speed-up the investigation, and get the issue settled quickly
get as many details as possible – not because he/she does not believe the complainant’s story
CD0390 — Harassment and bullying.answer: get as many details as possible – not because he/she does not believe the complainant’s story

CD0390 — Harassment and bullying.question: The female Third Officer feels embarrassed and humiliated every time the Second Officer touches her hand and looks at her with malice. The Second Officer’s behaviour is an example of ______?
options: Racial harassment
Discrimination
Cyber bullying
Sexual harassment
CD0390 — Harassment and bullying.answer: Sexual harassment

CD0390 — Harassment and bullying.question: _________ is a form of harassment where a person or group is made to feel frightened or intimidated through verbal or physical actions that are unacceptable, hostile, or not funny.
options: Racial harassment
Sexual harassment
Bullying
Threatening
CD0390 — Harassment and bullying.answer: Bullying

CD0390 — Harassment and bullying.question: Bullies do not _____. So during the direct confrontation, repeat what you have said, clearly and firmly, until it registers.
options: Listen
Back-off
Ask for forgiveness
Say too many words
CD0390 — Harassment and bullying.answer: Listen

CD0390 — Harassment and bullying.question: When you first realise you are being systematically picked on, start _______ where and when it occured, what happened, what was said by both parties, and how you felt.
options: sharing
memorising
recording
analysing
CD0390 — Harassment and bullying.answer: recording

CD0390 — Harassment and bullying.question: The Chief Officer tells the first timer Cadet that everyone goes through the same initiation in their first vessel. If you are the Cadet, how should you reply to the Chief Officer?
options: That is a silly idea which is totally unacceptable to me.
I wish I have the same guts to make through the initiation.
I believe seafaring is a professional work. It did not come into my mind that I will be joining a secret society.
I have no time for that useless exercise.
CD0390 — Harassment and bullying.answer: I believe seafaring is a professional work. It did not come into my mind that I will be joining a secret society.

CD0390 — Harassment and bullying.question: Which of the following situations can be classified as bullying?
options: The Chief Officer gives corrective feedback to the Third Officer who breached the safety procedures and highlights that he is not really surprised because the Third Officer comes from a carefree culture.
The Bosun gives short and sharp orders to the deck ratings in preparation for the inspection.
The Master reminds the Chief Cook about a previous commitment to adjust the weekly menu based on the collective feedback from the crew members.
The Chief Engineer calls the attention of the Fourth Engineer upon observing that the latter is not wearing the appropriate PPE.
CD0390 — Harassment and bullying.answer: The Chief Officer gives corrective feedback to the Third Officer who breached the safety procedures and highlights that he is not really surprised because the Third Officer comes from a carefree culture.

CD0390 — Harassment and bullying.question: Which of the following statements about bullying is FALSE?
options: Subordinates are also capable of bullying their superiors or colleagues.
Bullying may be done intentionally or not.
Bullying always involves an abuse of power or position.
Bullying may be carried out through verbal or physical actions.
CD0390 — Harassment and bullying.answer: Bullying always involves an abuse of power or position.

CD0390 — Harassment and bullying.question: A certain behaviour which is acceptable to some people may be unacceptable to another individual or group. What common characteristic of harassment and bullying is described?
options: Public humiliation
Performance complaints
Persistence
Differences in perception
CD0390 — Harassment and bullying.answer: Differences in perception

CD0390 — Harassment and bullying.question: The Second Engineer is not aware that his subordinates perceive him as a bully because of the alleged unfair allocation of work among the engine personnel. They believe that in this respect, they are being bullied. What should the Second Engineer do to address the situation?
options: Ensure that there is a transparent system for equitable and fair allocation of work.
Explain to every crew member that he only wants to finish the job on time. For this reason, the more reliable and competent people are given more work.
He does not need to be worried. The sentiment will die down naturally.
Reprimand those who question him.
CD0390 — Harassment and bullying.answer: Ensure that there is a transparent system for equitable and fair allocation of work.

CD0390 — Harassment and bullying.question: All of the following situations are examples of bullying EXCEPT which option?
options: The Bosun shouted at the OS who stepped inside the slip back zone while mooring operation is ongoing.
The first timer Cadet is subjected to jokes as a form of entertainment to the experienced crew members.
The AB who has a personal grudge against the OS took photos of the latter while drunk and posted these on Facebook.
The Chief Officer ordered the Deck Cadet to deliver air supply using a bucket.
CD0390 — Harassment and bullying.answer: The Bosun shouted at the OS who stepped inside the slip back zone while mooring operation is ongoing.

CD0390 — Harassment and bullying.question: What is the positive impact to the person being harassed or bullied of seeking help and support from other crew members?
options: It prevents the person from feeling isolated.
It enables the person to confidently give the bully a taste of his own medicine.
It solves harassment and bullying problems.
It makes both the person being bullied and the bully happy.
CD0390 — Harassment and bullying.answer: It prevents the person from feeling isolated.

CD0390 — Harassment and bullying.question: The persons who might be harassing or bullying others should break this habit through behavioural changes. What are the four behavioural tendencies that they should be made aware of?
options: Triggers, planning ahead, arousal signals, empathy
Triggers, positive thinking, arousal signals, enticement
Triggers, positive thinking, arousal signals, empathy
Training, positive thinking, assertiveness, empathy
CD0390 — Harassment and bullying.answer: Triggers, positive thinking, arousal signals, empathy

CD0390 — Harassment and bullying.question: Why is it important to be sensitive and patient when talking with the complainant or alleged bully?
options: Because they are always telling half-truths.
Because they are emotionally strong and effective communicators.
Because they are expected to be listening actively.

CD0416 — Fuel oil bunkering, Understandi.question: If marine residual fuel is found to contain catalytic fines, how should the separators be operated?^MSelect the ONE correct answer.

CD0416 — Fuel oil bunkering, Understandi.question: What corrective action can be taken if the residual fuel bunkered has a low net specific energy?^MSelect the ONE correct answer.

CD0416 — Fuel oil bunkering, Understandi.question: According to this module, how can wax formation with distillate fuel oils best be avoided?^MSelect the ONE best answer.

CD0416 — Fuel oil bunkering, Understandi.question: What action should be taken if a significant amount of water is discovered in the ship’s fuel oil?^MSelect the ONE best answer.

CD0416 — Fuel oil bunkering, Understandi.question: What difficulties can occur when a fuel with a low Calculated Cetane Index (CCI) is used?^MSelect the ONE correct answer.

CD0416 — Fuel oil bunkering, Understandi.question: According to this module, what special care is necessary when storing Type 2 and 3 ECA compliant fuels?^MSelect the ONE correct answer.

CD0416 — Fuel oil bunkering, Understandi.question: In relation to distillate fuels, what is the significance of FAME? ^MSelect the ONE correct answer.

CD0416 — Fuel oil bunkering, Understandi.question: Why is the pour point of a fuel important?^MSelect the ONE correct answer.

CD0416 — Fuel oil bunkering, Understandi.question: The condition of distillate fuels can often be quickly assessed by a visual inspection of the sample, ^Mwhich should be bright and clear. At what temperature should this test be carried out?^MSelect the ONE correct answer.

CD0416 — Fuel oil bunkering, Understandi.question: When are deposits in the engine due to Vanadium most likely to be a problem?^MSelect the ONE best answer.

CD0416 — Fuel oil bunkering, Understandi.question: Why is the Micro Carbon Residue of a distillate fuel important? ^MSelect the ONE correct answer.

CD0416 — Fuel oil bunkering, Understandi.question: Why are catalytic fines so problematic when present in residual fuel oil? ^MSelect the ONE correct answer.

CD0416 — Fuel oil bunkering, Understandi.question: What is the minimum allowable closed flash point of marine fuel oils used for propulsion?^MSelect the ONE correct answer.

CD0416 — Fuel oil bunkering, Understandi.question: How long should the MARPOL Annex VI sample be kept? ^MSelect the ONE correct answer.

CD0416 — Fuel oil bunkering, Understandi.question: Why is the Kinematic viscosity of residual fuel oils important? ^MSelect the ONE best answer.

CD0416 — Fuel oil bunkering, Understandi.answer: We need sufficient heating capacity to be able to reduce the viscosity for pumping,

CD0416 — Fuel oil bunkering, Understandi.question: Why is water contamination of distillate fuels a particular problem? ^MSelect the ONE best answer.

CD0416 — Fuel oil bunkering, Understandi.question: What is the ‘CCAI’ value of a fuel, and why is it significant? ^MSelect the ONE correct answer.

CD0416 — Fuel oil bunkering, Understandi.question: According to this module, how long should Bunker Delivery Notes (BDN) be kept on-board?^MSelect the ONE correct answer.

CD0418 — Bilge water separator, Part 1.question: Can you pump machinery space bilges whilst in a special area? Select the ONE best answer.

CD0420 — Lockout Tagout.question: You have been working on electrical, pneumatic or hydraulic equipment. What should be done about the controls for the equipment before re-energising it?

options: Соответствующая информация по охране и технике безопасности.
Характеристика груза на борту.
Численность команды на борту.
Имя капитана и электронный адрес для связи с судном.
CD0501 — Gangway security.answer: Соответствующая информация по охране и технике безопасности.

CD0501 — Gangway security.question: What is meant by ship security? Select the ONE best answer.
options: Being able to live and work onboard a vessel without danger or threat from others.
Having an armed response unit onboard in piracy areas.
Always being dressed properly and wearing the correct PPE.
Making sure that the cabin door is kept locked at all times in port and at sea.
CD0501 — Gangway security.answer: Being able to live and work onboard a vessel without danger or threat from others.

CD0501 — Gangway security.question: 船只安全的意义是什么？ 请选择一个最佳答案。
options: 能够在船上正常生活和工作，而不会受到来自他人的危险或威胁。
在船上私人区域具有武装响应部门。
总是穿着得当和佩戴正确的 PPE。
确保舱门在港口和海上随时保持锁闭。
CD0501 — Gangway security.answer: 能够在船上正常生活和工作，而不会受到来自他人的危险或威胁。

CD0501 — Gangway security.question: Что подразумевается под охраной судна? Выберите ОДИН наиболее подходящий вариант ответа.
options: Возможность жить и работать на борту, не подвергаясь угрозам или опасности со стороны других людей.
Наличие на борту вооруженного отряда реагирования в районах активности пиратов.
Постоянное ношение правильной одежды и СИЗ.
Слежение за тем, чтобы дверь каюты была всегда закрыта на замок, в порту и в море.
CD0501 — Gangway security.answer: Возможность жить и работать на борту, не подвергаясь угрозам или опасности со стороны других людей.

CD0501 — Gangway security.question: Which answer best completes the following statement? ‘The gangway security watch…
options: …represents the master’.
…is ineffective at stopping unwanted visitors’.
…should follow what the company security officer tells them when they visit’.
…is only there because of the ISPS code’.
CD0501 — Gangway security.answer: …represents the master’.

CD0501 — Gangway security.question: 请完成该说法。“舷梯安全值班…
options: …代表了船长”。
…在阻止不受欢迎的访客方面并没有效果”。
…应该遵循公司安全官员访问时告诉他们的内容”。
…只是为了遵循 ISPS code 才设置”。
CD0501 — Gangway security.answer: …代表了船长”。

CD0501 — Gangway security.question: Какой ответ лучше всего дополняет следующее утверждение? «Матрос, несущий вахту у трапа...
options: ... является представителем капитана».
... неэффективен в задержании нежелательных посетителей».
... должен исполнять только указания сотрудника службы безопасности компании».
... находится на посту только из-за Кодекса ОСПС».
CD0501 — Gangway security.answer: ... является представителем капитана».

CD0501 — Gangway security.question: What should the gangway security watch do if there is any doubt about a visitor? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: Contact the duty officer by radio or telephone.
Escort the visitor to the duty officer.
Let the visitor stay onboard the vessel.
Contact the agent for further clarification.
CD0501 — Gangway security.answer: Contact the duty officer by radio or telephone.

CD0501 — Gangway security.question: 如果舷梯安全值班人员对某个访客存疑，应该怎么做？ 请选择一个正确答案。
options: 通过无线电或电话联系值班主管。
护送访客到值班主管处。
让访客一直待在船上。
联系代理进一步澄清。
CD0501 — Gangway security.answer: 通过无线电或电话联系值班主管。

CD0501 — Gangway security.question: Что должен делать матрос, несущий вахту у трапа, если у него есть сомнения в отношении посетителя? Выберите ОДИН правильный вариант ответа.
options: Связаться с дежурным офицером по рации или по телефону.
Провести посетителя к дежурному офицеру.
Позволить посетителю остаться на борту судна.
Связаться с агентом для дальнейшего выяснения.
CD0501 — Gangway security.answer: Связаться с дежурным офицером по рации или по телефону.

CD0501 — Gangway security.question: When a vessel is tied up in a port with good security procedures, how should the vessel’s gangway security watch be seen? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: As the last line of defence for people coming on board.
As a waste of time because the port will deal with everything.
It can be set but then the crewmembers deployed on other work.
As only necessary during the hours of darkness.
CD0501 — Gangway security.answer: As the last line of defence for people coming on board.

CD0501 — Gangway security.question: 当船舶停靠在一个具有良好安全程序的港口时，应该如何看待船舶的舷梯安全值班人员？ 请选择一个正确答案。
options: 是针对企图登船人员的最后一道防线。
浪费时间，因为港口已经处理好了一切。
可以设置，但是船员安排了其他工作时不用。
仅在夜间需要。
CD0501 — Gangway security.answer: 是针对企图登船人员的最后一道防线。

CD0501 — Gangway security.question: Когда судно пришвартовано в порту с эффективными процедурами обеспечения безопасности, как следует рассматривать несение вахты у трапа? Выберите ОДИН правильный вариант ответа.
options: Как последнюю линию защиты для людей, заходящих на борт.
Как напрасную трату времени, поскольку порт обо всем позаботится.
Вахту можно поставить, но затем направить членов команды на другую работу.
Как меру, необходимую только в темное время суток.
CD0501 — Gangway security.answer: Как последнюю линию защиты для людей, заходящих на борт.

CD0501 — Gangway security.question: What two characteristic should a good gangway security watch show to a visitor? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: A welcoming attitude and firmness.
A welcoming attitude and a subordinate behaviour.
An aggressive attitude and behaviour that obstructs a visitor.
A dismissive attitude and just sign them in without question.
CD0501 — Gangway security.answer: A welcoming attitude and firmness.

CD0501 — Gangway security.question: 一个良好的舷梯安全值班应该向访客展示的两个特征是什么？ 请选择一个正确答案。
options: 欢迎态度和坚决性。
欢迎态度和谦卑行为。
阻挡访客的侵犯性态度和行为。
轻视态度，只是登记一下。
CD0501 — Gangway security.answer: 欢迎态度和坚决性。

CD0501 — Gangway security.question: Какие два качества должен проявлять вахтенный матрос по отношению к посетителю? Выберите ОДИН правильный вариант ответа.
options: Приветливость и твердость.
Приветливость и подчинение.
Агрессивность и поведение, отталкивающее посетителя.
Пренебрежение и регистрация без вопросов.
CD0501 — Gangway security.answer: Приветливость и твердость.

CD0501 — Gangway security.question: If you suspect an unwanted visitor has a weapon on their person what should you do? Select the ONE best answer.
options: Treat them with great caution and alert the duty officer.
Challenge them to hand over the weapon.
Try to bungle them down the gangway.
Ignore the fact that they have a weapon then seek shelter.
CD0501 — Gangway security.answer: Treat them with great caution and alert the duty officer.

CD0501 — Gangway security.question: 如果您怀疑某个不受欢迎的访客携带了武器，应该怎么做？ 请选择一个最佳答案。
options: 小心对待他们并向值班主管人员发出报警。
勒令他们交出武器。
尝试把他们推下舷梯。
忽略他们拥有武器的事实，然后寻求庇护地。
CD0501 — Gangway security.answer: 小心对待他们并向值班主管人员发出报警。

CD0501 — Gangway security.question: Что вы должны делать, если подозреваете, что нежелательный посетитель имеет при себе оружие? Выберите ОДИН наиболее подходящий вариант ответа.
options: Обходиться с ним очень осторожно и предупредить дежурного офицера.
Потребовать сдать оружие.
Попытаться спустить его с трапа.
Сделать вид, что не заметили оружия, а затем спрятаться в укрытие.
CD0501 — Gangway security.answer: Обходиться с ним очень осторожно и предупредить дежурного офицера.

CD0501 — Gangway security.question: What should the gangway security watch do if an unwanted visitor stays onboard and heads for the accommodation? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: Call the duty officer for assistance.
Chase after them and try and stop them.
Stop them at the gangway by grabbing them.
Just let them proceed, as someone else will find them.
CD0501 — Gangway security.answer: Call the duty officer for assistance.

CD0501 — Gangway security.question: 如果不受欢迎的访客一直待在船上并要进入船舱，舷梯安全值班人员应该怎么做？ 请选择一个正确答案。
options: 呼叫值班主管人员获取协助。
跟着并尝试阻止他们。
在舷梯抓住他们进行阻止。
让他们进去，总有别人会找到他们。
CD0501 — Gangway security.answer: 呼叫值班主管人员获取协助。

CD0501 — Gangway security.question: Что должен делать вахтенный матрос, если нежелательный посетитель остается на борту и направляется к каютам? Выберите ОДИН правильный вариант ответа.
options: Позвать на помощь дежурного офицера.
Последовать за ним и попытаться остановить.
Схватить его, чтобы задержать на трапе.
Позволить идти дальше, поскольку кто-то другой сможет его обнаружить.
CD0501 — Gangway security.answer: Позвать на помощь дежурного офицера.

CD0501 — Gangway security.question: Which answer best completes the following statement? ‘If a vessel has more than one gangway deployed…
options: …each one will need a security watch on it’.
…others should be stowed leaving one with a security watch’.
…it is difficult to maintain any security onboard’.
…they will normally be alongside each other requiring one security watch’.
CD0501 — Gangway security.answer: …each one will need a security watch on it’.

CD0501 — Gangway security.question: 请完成该说法。“如果船舶展开了多个舷梯…
options: …每个都需要一个安全值班”。
…其他应该收起，留下一个具有安全值班的舷梯”。
…很难保持任何船上安全”。
…通常并排展开，其中一个必须具有安全值班”。
CD0501 — Gangway security.answer: …每个都需要一个安全值班”。

CD0501 — Gangway security.question: Какой ответ лучше всего дополняет следующее утверждение? «Если с судна спущено больше одного трапа...
options: ... у каждого из них должен быть вахтенный матрос».
... остальные нужно поднять, оставив один с вахтенным матросом».
... становится трудно поддерживать охрану на судне».
... они обычно находятся рядом друг с другом, так что достаточно одного вахтенного матроса».
CD0501 — Gangway security.answer: ... у каждого из них должен быть вахтенный матрос».

CD0501 — Gangway security.question: Is the following statement true or false? ‘In a port with a good security system in operation, a ship does not need bother about their own security’.
options: False.
True.
CD0501 — Gangway security.answer: False.

CD0501 — Gangway security.question: 下面的陈述是真是假？ “在具有良好的安全系统的港口中，船只不需要担心自己的安全”。
options: 假。
真。
CD0501 — Gangway security.answer: 假。

CD0501 — Gangway security.question: Верно или неверно следующее утверждение? «В порту, где действует хорошая система охраны, команде судна незачем беспокоиться за свою безопасность».
options: Неверно.
Верно.
CD0501 — Gangway security.answer: Неверно.

CD0501 — Gangway security.question: What should be provided to the gangway security watch, to assist them decide if a visitor is legitimate? Select the ONE best answer.
options: There should be a list of visitors.
They should have a telephone to call the agent.
The visitor should be known by the security watch.
There should be photographs of expected visitors.
CD0501 — Gangway security.answer: There should be a list of visitors.

CD0501 — Gangway security.question: 如果访客是合法的，应该向舷梯安全值班人员提供什么来协助他们判断？ 请选择一个最佳答案。
options: 访客列表。
应该有一部电话能够呼叫代理。
安全值班人员应该认识该访客。
应该有预期访客的照片。
CD0501 — Gangway security.answer: 访客列表。

CD0501 — Gangway security.question: Что поможет матросу, несущему вахту у трапа, определить легальность посетителя? Выберите ОДИН наиболее подходящий вариант ответа.
options: У него должен быть список посетителей.
У него должен быть телефон для связи с агентом.
Он должен быть знаком с посетителем.
У него должны быть фотографии ожидаемых посетителей.
CD0501 — Gangway security.answer: У него должен быть список посетителей.

CD0501 — Gangway security.question: If a visitor cannot produce photo identification what should the security watch do? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: Ask them to go and get some.
Just let them onboard.
Let them onboard if they are on the visitor list.
Call the dock security gate to seek clarification.
CD0501 — Gangway security.answer: Ask them to go and get some.

CD0501 — Gangway security.question: 如果访客无法提供带照片的身份证件，安全值班人员应该怎么做？ 请选择一个正确答案。
options: 请他们去取。
让他们登船。
如果他们在访客列表上就让他们登船。
呼叫码头安全岗位进行澄清。
CD0501 — Gangway security.answer: 请他们去取。

CD0501 — Gangway security.question: Если посетитель не может предъявить удостоверения личности с фотографией, что должен делать вахтенный матрос? Выберите ОДИН правильный вариант ответа.
options: Попросить его принести какое-то удостоверение.
Просто пустить его на борт.
Пустить его на борт, если он значится в списке посетителей.
Позвонить на проходную дока для выяснения.
CD0501 — Gangway security.answer: Попросить его принести какое-то удостоверение.

CD0501 — Gangway security.question: What should visitors to a vessel show to the security watch, to verify their identity? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: Photographic identity of some sort.
A letter from the agent.
A valid job requisition.
A letter from the ship manager.
CD0501 — Gangway security.answer: Photographic identity of some sort.

CD0501 — Gangway security.question: 船舶访客应该向安全值班出示什么来验证其身份？ 请选择一个正确答案。
options: 带照片的身份证件。
来自代理的信件。
有效工作申请。
来自船只管理者的信件。
CD0501 — Gangway security.answer: 带照片的身份证件。

CD0501 — Gangway security.question: Что посетители судна должны предъявить вахтенному матросу для подтверждения личности? Выберите ОДИН правильный вариант ответа.
options: Какое-либо удостоверение личности с фотографией.
Письмо от агента.
Действительную заявку на подбор персонала.
Письмо оператора судна.
CD0501 — Gangway security.answer: Какое-либо удостоверение личности с фотографией.

CD0501 — Gangway security.question: If an unexpected visitor, such as the padre is found to be genuine, what should the gangway watch do? Select the ONE best answer.
options: They should get permission for the visitor to stay onboard.
They should ask the visitor to leave.
They should ask the duty officer to come to the gangway.
They should ask the visitor to stay on the quay until an officer arrives.
CD0501 — Gangway security.answer: They should get permission for the visitor to stay onboard.

CD0501 — Gangway security.question: 如果发现一个非预期访客为真正的访客，如牧师，舷梯值班人员应该怎么做？ 请选择一个最佳答案。
options: 他们应该获取访客登船的许可。
他们应该请访客离开。
他们应该请值班主管来舷梯。
他们应该请访客待在码头指导主管人员到达。
CD0501 — Gangway security.answer: 他们应该获取访客登船的许可。

CD0501 — Gangway security.question: Если выяснилось, что неожиданный посетитель, например судовой священник, является добросовестным, что должен делать вахтенный матрос? Выберите ОДИН наиболее подходящий вариант ответа.
options: Достать для него разрешение остаться на борту.
Попросить его покинуть трап.
Попросить дежурного офицера подойти к трапу.
Попросить посетителя подождать на причале, пока придет офицер.
CD0501 — Gangway security.answer: Достать для него разрешение остаться на борту.

CD0501 — Gangway security.question: Before the ISPS code was introduced, how did port directors manage security? Select the ONE best answer.
options: In whatever way that they thought best.
Very poorly.
A lot better than they do now.
Using guidance contained in the Code of Safe Working Practices.
CD0501 — Gangway security.answer: In whatever way that they thought best.

CD0501 — Gangway security.question: 引入 ISPS code 之前，港口主管如何管理安全？ 请选择一个最佳答案。
options: 以他们认为最好的方式。
非常差。
比现在好得多。
使用安全工作规范守则中的指南。
CD0501 — Gangway security.answer: 以他们认为最好的方式。

CD0501 — Gangway security.question: Как диспетчеры портов обеспечивали охрану до введения Кодекса ОСПС? Выберите ОДИН наиболее подходящий вариант ответа.
options: Так, как им казалось лучше.
Очень плохо.
Намного лучше, чем сейчас.
Используя инструкции, содержащиеся в Кодексе безопасной практики работы.
CD0501 — Gangway security.answer: Так, как им казалось лучше.

CD0501 — Gangway security.question: Where are details of visitors and the numbers of the passes issued to them kept? Select the ONE correct answer.
options: In the visitor logbook at the security checkpoint.
In the bridge deck logbook.
Nowhere as the pass contains the details required.
In the ship’s office computer.
CD0501 — Gangway security.answer: In the visitor logbook at the security checkpoint.

CD0501 — Gangway security.question: 访客的详细信息和发放给他们的通行证的编号位于什么位置？ 请选择一个正确答案。
options: 安全检查点的访客记录簿中。
在驾驶台甲板日记簿中。
通行证中包含了必需的信息，别处没有。
船只的办公室计算机中。
CD0501 — Gangway security.answer: 安全检查点的访客记录簿中。

CD0501 — Gangway security.question: Где хранится информация о посетителях и количестве выданных пропусков? Выберите ОДИН правильный вариант ответа.
options: В журнале посетителей на контрольно-пропускном пункте.
В вахтенном журнале мостика.
Нигде, так как в пропуске есть вся необходимая информация.
В компьютере судовой канцелярии.
CD0501 — Gangway security.answer: В журнале посетителей на контрольно-пропускном пункте.

CD0502 — Human behaviours, How did that.question: Which option BEST completes the following statement regarding pressure? ‘As soon as you recognise that a deadline will not be achieved…’
options: ‘…continue to work at a safe pace and reschedule the deadline.’
‘…push yourself to work faster so that you can meet the deadline.’
‘…cut corners so that it will take less time to complete the task.’
‘…tell your supervisor that you will miss the deadline so there is no point in completing the task.’
CD0502 — Human behaviours, How did that.answer: ‘…continue to work at a safe pace and reschedule the deadline.’

CD0502 — Human behaviours, How did that.question: Is the following statement true or false? ‘If you want to avoid distractions while working on a safety critical task, erect barriers and place signs to ensure you are not interrupted.’
options: True.
False.
CD0502 — Human behaviours, How did that.answer: True.

CD0502 — Human behaviours, How did that.question: Which option BEST completes the following sentence? ‘When you lack knowledge…’
options: ‘…stop and ask for help. Get the training and experience you need before coming back to it.’
‘…try to figure it out on your own.’
‘…accept that you will never learn what you need to know, and ask someone else to do it.’
‘…attempt the task as best you can and set time aside in the future to undergo further training.’
CD0502 — Human behaviours, How did that.answer: ‘…stop and ask for help. Get the training and experience you need before coming back to it.’

CD0502 — Human behaviours, How did that.question: According to this module, which of the following does NOT describe a type of human error?
options: Operative errors.
Action errors.
Thinking errors.
Violations.
CD0502 — Human behaviours, How did that.answer: Operative errors.

CD0502 — Human behaviours, How did that.question: Is the following statement about norms true or false? ‘If you know something is safe practice, stick to it.’
options: True.
False.
CD0502 — Human behaviours, How did that.answer: True.

CD0502 — Human behaviours, How did that.question: What should you do if you feel fatigued while working?
options: Tell your supervisor and do not undertake difficult or safety critical tasks.
Drink extra coffee and carry on with your work.
Go to your cabin to take an unscheduled break.
Use the times you are not working to catch up on your duties.
CD0502 — Human behaviours, How did that.answer: Tell your supervisor and do not undertake difficult or safety critical tasks.

CD0502 — Human behaviours, How did that.question: Which option BEST completes the following sentence? ‘Violations…’

CD0510 — Onboard paint maintenance, Insp.question: In some cases, discoloration resulting from contamination can be reversed. ^MHow might this be achieved?

CD0529 — Elementary first aid, Fractures.question: Aşağıdaki yaralanmalardan hangisi için destek askısı kullanılabilir?

CD0529 — Elementary first aid, Fractures.question: При какой из следующих травм необходимо использовать поддерживающую повязку?

CD0529 — Elementary first aid, Fractures.question: How should a dislocation be supported?

Manipulate it back into position and strap the limb down.
Move the limb into a position where it is easy to apply support.
Don’t support the injury just leave it alone.

CD0529 — Elementary first aid, Fractures.question: 如何支撑脱位？

将其恢复原位，并向下帮助肢体。
将肢体移动到一个易于支撑的位置。
不要支撑受伤部位，不管它。
CD0529 — Elementary first aid, Fractures.answer: 原位支撑，因为这对于伤者来说可能最舒适。

CD0529 — Elementary first aid, Fractures.question: Çıkma nasıl desteklenir?
options: Kazazede için en rahatı bulunan konum olacağından o pozisyonda destekleyin.
Elinizle yerine itin ve uzvu kayışla bağlayın.
Uzvu destek uygulaması kolay olan pozisyona getirin.
Yaralıyı desteklemeyin, yalnız bırakın yeter.
CD0529 — Elementary first aid, Fractures.answer: Kazazede için en rahatı bulunan konum olacağından o pozisyonda destekleyin.

CD0529 — Elementary first aid, Fractures.question: Каким образом осуществляется фиксация смещенного сустава?

Вправить сустав, выпрямить конечность вниз и зафиксировать ремнем.
Поместить конечность в такое положение, в котором его удобно зафиксировать.
Фиксация травмы не требуется, просто не трогать это место.
CD0529 — Elementary first aid, Fractures.answer: Зафиксировать сустав в текущем положении, так как, скорее всего, так удобнее всего для пострадавшего.

CD0529 — Elementary first aid, Fractures.question: Como se deve fornecer apoio a uma luxação?
options: Apoiar a luxação na posição encontrada, por ser mais confortável para a vítima.
Recolocá-la na posição correta e firmar o membro para baixo.
Mover o membro para uma posição em que seja fácil fornecer apoio.
Não fornecer apoio à lesão, deixando-a quieta.
CD0529 — Elementary first aid, Fractures.answer: Apoiar a luxação na posição encontrada, por ser mais confortável para a vítima.

CD0529 — Elementary first aid, Fractures.question: For which of the following injuries would an elevation sling be used?
options: Injury to any area around the arm, including support for rib fractures
Fractured wrist
Injury to the elbow
Open fracture to the lower arm
CD0529 — Elementary first aid, Fractures.answer: Injury to any area around the arm, including support for rib fractures

CD0529 — Elementary first aid, Fractures.question: 对于以下哪个受伤应该使用抬升吊带？
options: 胳膊周围任何部位的受伤，包括肋骨骨折支撑
腕部骨折
肘部受伤
下臂的开放型骨折
CD0529 — Elementary first aid, Fractures.answer: 胳膊周围任何部位的受伤，包括肋骨骨折支撑

CD0529 — Elementary first aid, Fractures.question: Aşağıdaki yaralanmalardan hangisi için kaldırma askısı kullanılabilir?
options: Kaburga kırıkları için desteğin dahil olduğu kol etrafında herhangi bir yerdeki yaralanma
Kırık kol bileği
Dirsek yaralanmalarında
Alt kolda açık yara
CD0529 — Elementary first aid, Fractures.answer: Kaburga kırıkları için desteğin dahil olduğu kol etrafında herhangi bir yerdeki yaralanma

CD0529 — Elementary first aid, Fractures.question: При какой из следующих травм необходимо использовать поддерживающую повязку для фиксации руки в приподнятом состоянии?
options: При травме любой области вокруг руки, в том числе поддержка при переломе ребер
Перелом запястья
Травма локтя
Открытый перелом предплечья
CD0529 — Elementary first aid, Fractures.answer: При травме любой области вокруг руки, в том числе поддержка при переломе ребер

CD0529 — Elementary first aid, Fractures.question: Para qual das seguintes lesões deve-se utilizar uma tipoia alta?
options: Lesão em qualquer área perto do braço, incluindo fraturas das costelas
Fratura de pulso
Lesão no cotovelo
Fratura exposta do antebraço
CD0529 — Elementary first aid, Fractures.answer: Lesão em qualquer área perto do braço, incluindo fraturas das costelas

CD0529 — Elementary first aid, Fractures.question: Which of the following is NOT a sign of impaired blood circulation?
options: When pressed the nail goes white. It turns pink when released.
There is no pulse present below the site of the fracture.
The limb is cold.
The skin below the fracture is very white or pale.
CD0529 — Elementary first aid, Fractures.answer: When pressed the nail goes white. It turns pink when released.

CD0529 — Elementary first aid, Fractures.question: 下面哪个不属于受损血液循环的迹象？
options: 按压手指时变白。松开时变为粉色。
骨折部位下面没有脉搏。
肢体温度较低。
骨折下面的皮肤发白或苍白。
CD0529 — Elementary first aid, Fractures.answer: 按压手指时变白。松开时变为粉色。

CD0529 — Elementary first aid, Fractures.question: Aşağıdakilerden hangisi bozuk kan dolaşımı işareti DEĞİLDİR?
options: Baskı uygulandığında tırnak beyazlaşır. Serbest bırakıldığında pembeleşir.
Kırık alanı altında nabız yok.
Organ soğuk.
Kırık altındaki cilt çok beyaz veya solgun.
CD0529 — Elementary first aid, Fractures.answer: Baskı uygulandığında tırnak beyazlaşır. Serbest bırakıldığında pembeleşir.

CD0529 — Elementary first aid, Fractures.question: Что из следующего НЕ является признаком нарушения кровообращения?
options: При нажатии ноготь белеет. А если отпустить — розовеет.
Ниже места перелома не прощупывается пульс.
Конечность холодная.
Кожа ниже места перелома белая или очень бледная.
CD0529 — Elementary first aid, Fractures.answer: При нажатии ноготь белеет. А если отпустить — розовеет.

CD0529 — Elementary first aid, Fractures.question: Qual dos seguintes sinais NÃO indica perda de circulação sanguínea?
options: Quando pressionada, a unha fica branca. E fica rosada quando solta.
Ausência de pulso abaixo do local da fratura.
O membro está frio.
A pele sob a fratura está muito branca ou pálida.
CD0529 — Elementary first aid, Fractures.answer: Quando pressionada, a unha fica branca. E fica rosada quando solta.

CD0529 — Elementary first aid, Fractures.question: Is the following statement true or false? ‘If a casualty has dislocated a limb, we should quickly manipulate the joint back into position.’
options: False
True
CD0529 — Elementary first aid, Fractures.answer: False

CD0529 — Elementary first aid, Fractures.question: 下面的陈述是真是假？ “如果伤者肢体脱位，我们应该快速让关节恢复原位。”

正确
CD0529 — Elementary first aid, Fractures.answer: 错误

CD0529 — Elementary first aid, Fractures.question: Aşağıdaki ifade doğru mu yanlış mı? "Kazazedenin çıkan bir uzvu varsa eklemi hızlı bir şekilde yerine itmeliyiz.'

Doğru

CD0529 — Elementary first aid, Fractures.question: Верно или неверно следующее утверждение? «Если у пострадавшего смещена конечность, необходимо быстро восстановить правильное положение сустава».

CD0529 — Elementary first aid, Fractures.question: Which of the options correctly completes the following sentence? ‘If there is no pulse present, we should attempt to restore circulation by…’

CD0529 — Elementary first aid, Fractures.question: Aşağıdaki cümleyi seçeneklerden hangisi doğru bir şekilde tamamlar? 'Nabız yoksa dolaşımı yerine getirmek için...'

CD0529 — Elementary first aid, Fractures.answer: '...nabız gelene kadar organı yavaşça hareket ettirmeliyiz.'

CD0529 — Elementary first aid, Fractures.question: Какой вариант ответа правильно дополняет следующее предложение? «Если отсутствует пульс, необходимо попытаться восстановить кровообращение, ...»

options: 错误

CD0529 — Elementary first aid, Fractures.answer: 错误

CD0529 — Elementary first aid, Fractures.question: Aşağıdaki ifade doğru mu yanlış mı? 'Omur yaralanmasından şüpheleniyorsak kazazedeyi mümkün olduğunca çabuk bir şekilde hareket ettirmeliyiz.'.

CD0529 — Elementary first aid, Fractures.question: Верно или неверно следующее утверждение? «При подозрении на травму позвоночника необходимо как можно быстрее перенести пострадавшего».

CD0530 — Elementary first aid, Transport.question: 如果伤者没有直接危险，应该在何时移动他们？

CD0530 — Elementary first aid, Transport.question: Kazazedeye yakın bir tehlike yoksa onu ne zaman hareket ettirmeyi düşünmelisiniz?

Mümkün olduğunca çabuk.
Birincil araştırmayı gerçekleştirdikten sonra.
Tıbbi boşaltma gerektiğinde.

CD0530 — Elementary first aid, Transport.question: Se não houver perigo imediato para a vítima, quando é possível movê-la?

CD0530 — Elementary first aid, Transport.question: 铲式担架的什么特性是它与其他担架的不同之处？

CD0530 — Elementary first aid, Transport.question: Kaşık sedyeyi diğer tüm sedyelerden ayıran özellikleri nelerdir?
