恶劣天气下留在一个位置。
CD0551 — Slips, trips and falls.answer: 一只手用于自己，一只手用于船只。

CD0551 — Slips, trips and falls.question: Which of the following factors has a positive effect on safety culture at a personal level?
options: Colleague wearing the correct PPE.
Complacency/Over-confidence.
Fatigue/Laziness.
Time pressures.
CD0551 — Slips, trips and falls.answer: Colleague wearing the correct PPE.

CD0551 — Slips, trips and falls.question: 以下哪个因素对个人级别的安全氛围会带来积极的影响？
options: 穿戴正确 PPE 的同事。
自满/自负。
疲劳/懒惰。
时间压力。
CD0551 — Slips, trips and falls.answer: 穿戴正确 PPE 的同事。

CD0555 — Workshop safety.question: Which of the following BEST describes the necessary precautions when welding in the workshop?
options: Operator wears proper PPE and ensures the welding curtain is in place.
Operator wears correct PPE.
Operator ensures welding curtain is in place.
Operator warns everyone in the workshop when about to strike an arc.
CD0555 — Workshop safety.answer: Operator wears proper PPE and ensures the welding curtain is in place.

CD0555 — Workshop safety.question: 在车间内焊接时，以下哪项是必需的预防措施？
options: 操作人员穿戴恰当的 PPE，确保焊接围挡就位。
操作人员佩戴正确的 PPE。
操作人员确保焊接围挡就位。
操作人员要激起电弧时向车间内的所有人发出警告。
CD0555 — Workshop safety.answer: 操作人员穿戴恰当的 PPE，确保焊接围挡就位。

CD0555 — Workshop safety.question: Which of the following is NOT a measure that will reduce the risk of slips, trips and falls in the workshop?
options: Allowing free access to all crewmembers when they want to borrow tools.
Mopping up any spills.
Keeping the deck clear of obstacles.
Ensuring the workshop is well lit.
CD0555 — Workshop safety.answer: Allowing free access to all crewmembers when they want to borrow tools.

CD0555 — Workshop safety.question: 以下哪项不是降低车间内滑倒、绊倒和跌倒风险的措施？
options: 要借工具时能够自由访问所有船员。
用抹布擦掉任何溢漏。
清理甲板障碍。
确保车间照明良好。
CD0555 — Workshop safety.answer: 要借工具时能够自由访问所有船员。

CD0555 — Workshop safety.question: Which of the following BEST completes the following sentence? All waste … .
options: should be properly separated so that it can be recycled or disposed of correctly.
should be put in the same bin and disposed of at the end of the day.
should be recycled or disposed of immediately. No waste should be left in the workshop.
should be incinerated at the end of each day.
CD0555 — Workshop safety.answer: should be properly separated so that it can be recycled or disposed of correctly.

CD0555 — Workshop safety.question: 下面哪个选项最好地完成了以下说法： 所有垃圾…
options: 应正确分类，以便可以回收或正确处置。
应放在同一个垃圾箱内，并在当天结束时处置。
应回收或立即处置。车间内不应留在任何垃圾。
应在每天结束时进行焚烧。
CD0555 — Workshop safety.answer: 应正确分类，以便可以回收或正确处置。

CD0555 — Workshop safety.question: Which of the following statements is NOT true?
options: Always leave the chuck key inserted in the machine.
Never operate a machine without the guards in place.
Always stop machinery before making adjustments or taking measurements.
Never attempt to remove cuttings with your hands or when the machine is moving.
CD0555 — Workshop safety.answer: Always leave the chuck key inserted in the machine.

CD0555 — Workshop safety.question: 以下哪项陈述不是真的？
options: 总是将夹头钥匙插在机器内。
护罩未就位时切勿操作机器。
进行调节或测量之前务必停止机器。
切勿用手或机器正在转动时去除切屑。
CD0555 — Workshop safety.answer: 总是将夹头钥匙插在机器内。

CD0555 — Workshop safety.question: Is the following statement true or false: ‘Any type of dust mask will work for all hazards.’
options: False.
True.
CD0555 — Workshop safety.answer: False.

CD0555 — Workshop safety.question: 下面的陈述是真是假： 任何类型的防尘面具对于所有危险均有效。
options: 错误。
正确。
CD0555 — Workshop safety.answer: 错误。

CD0555 — Workshop safety.question: Which of the following materials are appropriate to use on a grinding wheel?
options: Iron.
Wood.
Copper.
Aluminum.
CD0555 — Workshop safety.answer: Iron.

CD0555 — Workshop safety.question: 以下哪个材料适合使用砂轮？
options: 铁。
木材。
铜。
铝。
CD0555 — Workshop safety.answer: 铁。

CD0555 — Workshop safety.question: Who is at risk of injury if a chuck key is left in place when a machine is operated?
options: Anyone in the workshop.
The operator.
No one.
Anyone in or near the workshop.
CD0555 — Workshop safety.answer: Anyone in the workshop.

CD0555 — Workshop safety.question: 如果机器运行时夹头钥匙留在原位，谁会发生受伤危险？
options: 车间内的任何人。
操作人员。
没有人。
车间内或附近的任何人。
CD0555 — Workshop safety.answer: 车间内的任何人。

CD0555 — Workshop safety.question: Which of the following PPE is NOT required when welding in the workshop?
options: A thermal undergarment.
Gloves.
Heat resistant apron.
Face mask.
CD0555 — Workshop safety.answer: A thermal undergarment.

CD0555 — Workshop safety.question: 在车间内焊接时，以下哪个 PPE 不是必需的？
options: 发热内衣。
手套。
耐热围裙。
面罩。
CD0555 — Workshop safety.answer: 发热内衣。

CD0555 — Workshop safety.question: How do you know when ear defenders are needed in the workshop?
options: Appropriate signage will be placed where ear defenders are necessary.
Ear defenders aren’t necessary in the workshop, unless you’re using a circular saw.
Ear defenders are only necessary if you are close to an engine.
Ear defenders will only be necessary if two or more machines are operating at the same time.
CD0555 — Workshop safety.answer: Appropriate signage will be placed where ear defenders are necessary.

CD0555 — Workshop safety.question: 如何知道何时需要在车间内佩戴护耳装备？
options: 放置了恰当的标志，说明需佩戴护耳装备。
车间内无需护耳装备，除非使用圆形锯。
只有接近轮机时才需要护耳装备。
同时运行两台或多台机器时才需要护耳装备。
CD0555 — Workshop safety.answer: 放置了恰当的标志，说明需佩戴护耳装备。

CD0555 — Workshop safety.question: When should you enter the workshop?
options: Only when you have permission to do so.
If you have a simple task to undertake.
Only when there are other people in the workshop.
Whenever you have a task to complete.
CD0555 — Workshop safety.answer: Only when you have permission to do so.

CD0555 — Workshop safety.question: 应该何时进入车间？
options: 仅当获得授权时。
要完成简单任务时。
仅在车间内有其他人时。
每当要完成任务时。
CD0555 — Workshop safety.answer: 仅当获得授权时。

CD0555 — Workshop safety.question: Is the following statement true or false: ‘Grinding wheel discs should only be changed by those who have been trained to do so.’
options: True.
False.
CD0555 — Workshop safety.answer: True.

CD0555 — Workshop safety.question: 下面的陈述是真是假： 砂轮片只应由受过这方面训练的人更换。
options: 正确。
错误。
CD0555 — Workshop safety.answer: 正确。

CD0555 — Workshop safety.question: Where can specific information be found regarding the special precautions to take when handling chemicals in the workshop?
options: The Material Safety Data Sheet.
Safety Management System.
Chief Engineer’s standing orders.
Workshop procedures.
CD0555 — Workshop safety.answer: The Material Safety Data Sheet.

CD0555 — Workshop safety.question: 在车间内处理化学品时，在何处可以找到有关要采取特殊预防措施的具体信息？
options: 材料安全数据表。
安全管理体系。
轮机长的规程。
车间程序。
CD0555 — Workshop safety.answer: 材料安全数据表。

CD0555 — Workshop safety.question: Which of the following risks is NOT likely to be caused by leaving tools lying around?
options: Fall and put a hole in the deck.
Fall to the deck because of a trip hazard.
Fall into machinery and be thrown across the workshop.
Fall against a hot surface and be burned.
CD0555 — Workshop safety.answer: Fall and put a hole in the deck.

CD0555 — Workshop safety.question: 将工具随处乱扔不会导致下面哪个危险？
options: 掉落，在甲板上砸一个洞。
由于绊倒危险摔倒在甲板上。
掉到机械中，并在车间内抛出。
掉在高温表面上发生燃烧。
CD0555 — Workshop safety.answer: 掉落，在甲板上砸一个洞。

CD0555 — Workshop safety.question: Which of the following is NOT a precaution required when operating machinery in the workshop?
options: Wear trainers with good grips on the bottom.
Remove jewelry before entering.
Tie back long hair.
Wearing close fitting overalls.
CD0555 — Workshop safety.answer: Wear trainers with good grips on the bottom.

CD0555 — Workshop safety.question: 在车间内操作机械时，以下哪项不是必需的预防措施？
options: 穿鞋底抓地稳固的运动鞋。
进入之前摘下首饰。
扎起长发。
穿着紧身全身工作服。
CD0555 — Workshop safety.answer: 穿鞋底抓地稳固的运动鞋。

CD0555 — Workshop safety.question: When is eye protection required in the workshop?
options: Whenever there is a risk of sparks, dust and particles getting into the operator’s eyes.
Only when there is no guard on the machine.
Only when using chemicals.
When there are auditors and port State Officers on board.
CD0555 — Workshop safety.answer: Whenever there is a risk of sparks, dust and particles getting into the operator’s eyes.

CD0555 — Workshop safety.question: 车间内何时必需护眼装备？
options: 存在火花、灰尘和颗粒进入操作人员眼睛的风险时。
仅当机器上没有护罩时。
仅当使用化学品时。
船上有审计员和港口国官员时。
CD0555 — Workshop safety.answer: 存在火花、灰尘和颗粒进入操作人员眼睛的风险时。

CD0556 — Hand tool safety.question: Where should you put your hands when using a cutting tool? Select the BEST answer.
options: Both hands behind the cutting edge of the tool.
One hand in front and one hand behind the tool.
Keep one hand behind the cutting edge of the tool and the other hand well out of the way.
Keep one hand behind the cutting edge of the tool and the other hand holding the work piece.
CD0556 — Hand tool safety.answer: Both hands behind the cutting edge of the tool.

CD0556 — Hand tool safety.question: 使用切割工具时手应该放在何处？ 请选择最佳答案。
options: 双手位于工具尖锐边缘后面。
一只手在前，一只手在工具后面。
一只手在工具尖锐边缘后面，另一只手远远离开。
一只手在工具尖锐边缘后面，另一只手拿住工件。
CD0556 — Hand tool safety.answer: 双手位于工具尖锐边缘后面。

CD0556 — Hand tool safety.question: Which of the options best completes the following sentence: Tools should only be ground or sharpened … .
options: by someone competent to do so.
by the person about to use them.
when they are so blunt they cannot be used.
by the Chief Engineer.
CD0556 — Hand tool safety.answer: by someone competent to do so.

CD0556 — Hand tool safety.question: 下面哪个选项最好地完成了以下说法： 工具的磨平或磨尖应 …
options: 由有资格人员进行。
由打算使用它的人进行。
在已经很钝，无法使用时进行。
由轮机长进行。
CD0556 — Hand tool safety.answer: 由有资格人员进行。

CD0556 — Hand tool safety.question: Which of the following statements is NOT true about cables and hoses?
options: They should never be used during heavy weather.
They should be laid out carefully.
They should not be run over sharp edges.
They should not obstruct safe passage around the ship.
CD0556 — Hand tool safety.answer: They should never be used during heavy weather.

CD0556 — Hand tool safety.question: 下面关于线缆和软管的说法中，哪个不是真的？
options: 绝不应在恶劣天气下使用。
应该仔细布线。
不应在尖锐边缘上经过。
不应阻碍船上的各种安全通道。
CD0556 — Hand tool safety.answer: 绝不应在恶劣天气下使用。

CD0556 — Hand tool safety.question: Is the following statement true or false: Battery powered equipment is a safe alternative to reduce the risk of electric shock.
options: True.
False.
CD0556 — Hand tool safety.answer: True.

CD0556 — Hand tool safety.question: 下面的陈述是真是假： 电池供电设备是降低触电风险的一项安全备选措施。
options: 正确。
错误。
CD0556 — Hand tool safety.answer: 正确。

CD0556 — Hand tool safety.question: Which of the following statements is true for the correct usage of hand tools?
options: If you need a chisel, go and get the right tool for the job.
If there is no chisel to hand, use a screwdriver instead.
It doesn’t matter what tool you use, just as long as you get the job done.
It is fine to use the wrong tool as long as you wear additional PPE.
CD0556 — Hand tool safety.answer: If you need a chisel, go and get the right tool for the job.

CD0556 — Hand tool safety.question: 关于手持工具正确用法，下面哪个说法是真的？
options: 如果需要使用凿子，则去取一个适合作业的工具。
如果手头没有凿子，则使用螺丝刀代替。
使用什么工具都没关系，只要作业完成就好。
使用错误工具也没问题，只要穿戴附加 PPE 即可。
CD0556 — Hand tool safety.answer: 如果需要使用凿子，则去取一个适合作业的工具。

CD0556 — Hand tool safety.question: When working with noisy hand tools, what PPE should be worn?
options: Ear defenders and gloves.
Just ear defenders.
Just gloves.
No PPE is required.
CD0556 — Hand tool safety.answer: Ear defenders and gloves.

CD0556 — Hand tool safety.question: 使用噪声较大的手持工具时，应该穿戴什么 PPE？
options: 护耳装备和手套。
仅护耳装备。
仅手套。
无需 PPE。
CD0556 — Hand tool safety.answer: 护耳装备和手套。

CD0556 — Hand tool safety.question: Which of the following statements about using spanners is true?
options: Always try to pull the spanner towards you.
Always try to push the spanner away from you.
When you can, always use an adjustable instead of the correct sized spanner.
Worn, splayed or badly fitting spanners should only be used if nothing else is to hand.
CD0556 — Hand tool safety.answer: Always try to pull the spanner towards you.

CD0556 — Hand tool safety.question: 以下关于使用扳手的哪项陈述是真的？
options: 总是朝着自己的方向拉扳手。
总是朝着远离自己的方向推扳手。
如果可以，总是使用可调节大小的扳手，而不要使用正确大小的扳手。
只有手头没有其他工具可用时才使用损坏、磨平或安装错误的扳手。
CD0556 — Hand tool safety.answer: 总是朝着自己的方向拉扳手。

CD0556 — Hand tool safety.question: Is the following statement true or false: Double insulated power tools used ashore are suitable for use on board.
options: False.
True.
CD0556 — Hand tool safety.answer: False.

CD0556 — Hand tool safety.question: 下面的陈述是真是假： 岸上使用的双重绝缘电动工具适合船上使用。
options: 错误。
正确。
CD0556 — Hand tool safety.answer: 错误。

CD0556 — Hand tool safety.question: According to this module, what is the maximum voltage for hand tools recommended by some authorities?
options: 50V AC.
10V AC.
60V AC.
100V AC.
CD0556 — Hand tool safety.answer: 50V AC.

CD0556 — Hand tool safety.question: 根据本模块的内容，某些机构建议手动工具的最大电压是多少？
options: 50V AC。
10V AC。
60V AC。
100V AC。
CD0556 — Hand tool safety.answer: 50V AC。

CD0556 — Hand tool safety.question: Which of the following statements is NOT true about the proper care and maintenance of files?
options: They should only be cared for by engineers.
They should be stored properly.
They should have handles that are properly fitted and in good condition.
When stored, they should avoid metal to metal contact with other tools.
CD0556 — Hand tool safety.answer: They should only be cared for by engineers.

CD0556 — Hand tool safety.question: 下面关于锉刀正确护理和保养的说法中，哪个不是真的？
options: 应该由工程师进行护理。
应该正确存放。
应该正确安装手柄并保持状况良好。
存放时应避免与其他工具发生金属与金属接触。
CD0556 — Hand tool safety.answer: 应该由工程师进行护理。

CD0556 — Hand tool safety.question: According to this module, what is the maximum voltage for hand lamps recommended by some authorities?
根据本模块的内容，某些机构建议手动照明灯的最大电压是多少？
Which of the options best completes the following sentence: Mushrooming on a chisel is dangerous because … .
options: pieces of metal can fly off next time the chisel is struck.
it makes it more likely that the chisel will get stuck.
it is more likely to slice open a finger.
it means the chisel is likely to split in two.
CD0556 — Hand tool safety.answer: pieces of metal can fly off next time the chisel is struck.

CD0556 — Hand tool safety.question: 下面哪个选项最好地完成了以下说法： 凿子上的蘑菇变形很危险，因为…
options: 下次敲击凿子时可能会飞出金属片。
凿子可能更容易卡住。
更容易划破手指。
意味着凿子很容易列成两半。
CD0556 — Hand tool safety.answer: 下次敲击凿子时可能会飞出金属片。

CD0556 — Hand tool safety.question: Which of the options best completes the following sentence: If hoses or cables pass through a doorway … .
options: the door should be secured open to prevent it closing on them and causing damaged.
the door should be rested comfortably against them to prevent movement and stop the door closing.
everyone in the vicinity should be notified.
put a wet floor sign nearby to capture peoples’ attention.
CD0556 — Hand tool safety.answer: the door should be secured open to prevent it closing on them and causing damaged.

CD0556 — Hand tool safety.question: 下面哪个选项最好地完成了以下说法： 如果软管或线缆穿过门通道…
options: 则应该将这些门固定在打开状态，防止门关闭时卡住这些线缆导致损伤。
门应该自然地抵在这些线缆上，防止移动和门关闭。
应通知附近的所有人。
在附近放置一个湿滑地面标志，引起人们注意。
CD0556 — Hand tool safety.answer: 则应该将这些门固定在打开状态，防止门关闭时卡住这些线缆导致损伤。

CD0556 — Hand tool safety.question: Which option best completes the following sentence: When working at height, you should… .
options: use a tool belt and only take the tools you need.
carry tools in your pockets if necessary.
keep tools in your hands so they are secure.
bring additional tools with you to ensure you don’t need to come down to get more.
CD0556 — Hand tool safety.answer: use a tool belt and only take the tools you need.

CD0556 — Hand tool safety.question: 下面哪个选项最好地完成了以下说法： 高空作业时，您应该…
options: 使用工具腰带，仅携带所需的工具。
如有必要在口袋中携带工具。
将工具一直拿在手中，这样就安全了。
携带多余工具，确保不用再下来拿。
CD0556 — Hand tool safety.answer: 使用工具腰带，仅携带所需的工具。

CD0556 — Hand tool safety.question: When working with hand tools, what should you do if you feel your hands going numb or cold?
options: Take a break and report the symptoms if they persist.
Go straight to the medical officer and ask to be taken off duty.
Take a five minute break, and then continue even if the symptoms persist.
Continue working, as this is normal.
CD0556 — Hand tool safety.answer: Take a break and report the symptoms if they persist.

CD0556 — Hand tool safety.question: 使用手持工具时，如果感觉到手部麻木或发冷，应该怎么做？
options: 休息一下，如果仍然症状仍然存在则进行报告。
直接去找医疗官员，请求休假。
休息五分钟，即使症状仍然存在也仍然继续。
继续作业，因为这是正常的。
CD0556 — Hand tool safety.answer: 休息一下，如果仍然症状仍然存在则进行报告。
